movies.title: Coyote vs. Acme
movies.plot: After a string of failed products derails his pursuit of a speedy rival, a determined desert animal turns to a billboard lawyer for help. Together, they take on the powerful company behind the inventions, launching a high-stakes legal battle rooted in cartoon rivalry and slapstick frustration.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movies.plot: Working full-time as Spider-Man in a city that no longer remembers him, a lonely young hero struggles as old friends move on and strange changes begin affecting his powers. When an unseen enemy threatens the city and those he loves, he must confront a dangerous transformation while searching for a way to stop the growing crisis.

movies.title: The Odyssey
movies.plot: After a devastating war, a legendary king begins a dangerous journey home across a world filled with gods, monsters, and unpredictable trials. As he struggles to survive and return to his family, the voyage tests his intelligence, courage, guilt, and sense of humanity.

movies.title: Mutiny
movies.plot: After witnessing a billionaire's murder and being framed for the crime, a man boards a cargo ship on a solitary quest for revenge. His pursuit takes him into an international conspiracy, forcing him to confront danger while seeking answers and justice.

movies.title: The Runner
movies.plot: Maia Marten, a brilliant London lawyer, has her life shattered by a single call on her morning run: her son has been taken. To get him back, she must keep running, obey every ruthless command, and trust no one-each second a test of how far a mother will go to save her child.

movies.title: The Last Sunrise
movies.plot: A college student with a chronic illness travels to Mallorca with her mother for the summer. After falling for a local, she starts embracing the present, but worsening health and family secrets threaten the life and connections she has discovered.

movies.title: Obsession
movies.plot: A hopeless romantic uses a mysterious wish-granting trinket to win his longtime crush’s heart. When the wish comes true, the relationship takes a sinister turn, trapping both of them in an increasingly unsettling nightmare where desire, control, and free will collide.

movies.title: Toy Story 5
movies.plot: A young child becomes absorbed in a new tablet, leaving her beloved toys struggling to stay part of playtime. As the device changes their world, the toys must work together to protect their place in her life and confront an unexpected new threat.

movies.title: Minions & Monsters
movies.plot: A group of mischievous yellow stars rises from struggling filmmakers to Hollywood sensations, only to lose their success when movies change. After discovering an ancient spell and unleashing a monster, they must work together to stop the growing chaos and protect the world from their cinematic misadventure.

movies.title: Facing El Chapo
movies.plot: Two law-enforcement officers face the final hours of a dangerous shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss. As pressure mounts, they must survive an increasingly perilous situation while confronting the consequences of standing in the way of powerful criminal forces.

movies.title: Clash of the Thundermans
movies.plot: When a young superhero develops a destructive new power, a hero organization sends her to an elite school to learn control. Her family divides over the decision, with some taking her into hiding while others search for them, leading to a high-stakes clash over the family’s future.

movies.title: Toxic
movies.plot: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

movies.title: Colony
movies.plot: A scientist is caught in a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus spreads during a biotech conference, prompting authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with a small group of survivors, the scientist must fight to stay alive as the infected undergo horrific transformations.

movies.title: Mayday
movies.plot: During the Cold War, a U.S. Navy pilot becomes stranded behind enemy lines while carrying out a top-secret mission. With survival uncertain, he must depend on an unlikely alliance with an eccentric former KGB agent to find a way forward.

movies.title: Ghost in the Cell
movies.plot: In a notorious prison, an invisible force begins brutally killing inmates, forcing rival gangs and corrupt guards into an uneasy alliance. As the bloodshed intensifies, they must work together to survive an unseen threat within the prison’s walls.

movies.title: The Whisper Man
movies.plot: After his young son disappears, a widower seeks help from his estranged father, a retired detective. Together, they confront a chilling case connected to a serial killer the older man once helped put away, forcing them to revisit a dangerous and deeply troubling past.

movies.title: Disclosure Day
movies.plot: A cybersecurity expert becomes a whistleblower after uncovering evidence of hidden alien secrets, forcing him to flee a powerful corporation. A meteorologist experiencing disturbing phenomena joins him, and together they race to reveal proof of life beyond human understanding while navigating a dangerous conspiracy.

movies.title: Batman: Knightfall - Part 1: Knightfall
movies.plot: After a notorious prison is destroyed, its inmates are unleashed across the city. A masked vigilante races to recapture dangerous enemies while being pushed to his physical and mental limits by a powerful new threat.

movies.title: Moana
movies.plot: A young islander answers the ocean’s call and ventures beyond her home’s protective reef when her people face a serious threat. Joined by a powerful demigod, she sets out across the sea to restore a sacred source of life and bring prosperity back to her community.

movies.title: War of the Worlds
movies.plot: A government threat analyst monitors potential dangers through a mass surveillance system when an attack by an unknown entity disrupts everything. As the crisis unfolds, he begins questioning whether officials are concealing vital information from him and the public.

movies.title: Pinocchio: Unstrung
movies.plot: Created by a toymaker and influenced by a sinister cricket, a wooden boy begins a violent quest to become human. Driven by his desire to match his brother, he sets out to transform himself piece by piece.

movies.title: Rage of Stars
movies.plot: A woman serving in an international special forces unit experiences a disturbing premonition about humanity’s impending end. As the threat takes shape, she must confront an extraordinary crisis that reaches far beyond ordinary military missions.

movies.title: Rosebush Pruning
movies.plot: In a luxurious Spanish villa, four American siblings live in isolation, spending their inherited wealth while remaining trapped in a tense family dynamic. When one sibling plans to leave with a girlfriend and another investigates their mother’s death, long-buried tensions begin to tear the family apart.

movies.title: Above and Below
movies.plot: A group of friends heads out on a vacation filled with partying and diving. Their adventure takes a terrifying turn when criminals attack them in open waters, forcing the group to confront a sudden and dangerous threat far from safety.

movies.title: Project Hail Mary
movies.plot: A science teacher wakes aboard a spaceship light-years from Earth with no memory of his identity or mission. As his memories return, he learns that a mysterious substance is threatening the Sun and must use his scientific knowledge, ingenuity, and unconventional ideas to help prevent a global catastrophe.

movies.title: Backrooms
movies.plot: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.

movies.title: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu
movies.plot: After the Empire’s fall, scattered Imperial warlords threaten the fragile peace as the New Republic tries to protect the galaxy. A legendary Mandalorian bounty hunter and his young apprentice are called upon to confront this continuing danger, balancing dangerous missions with the bond that holds them together.

movies.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
movies.plot: After a young superhero’s secret identity is exposed, his ordinary life becomes impossible to separate from his dangerous responsibilities. Seeking magical help to restore privacy, he triggers a crisis that brings powerful threats into his world and forces him to reconsider what being a hero truly demands.

movies.title: Scary Movie
movies.plot: Twenty-six years after surviving a suspiciously familiar masked killer, four returning survivors find themselves targeted again. As the threat resurfaces, the story turns its attention toward modern horror conventions, familiar franchise formulas, and the wider movie industry in an absurd parody packed with nostalgia, pop-culture references, and fast-moving comic set pieces.

movies.title: The Shawshank Redemption
movies.plot: A banker imprisoned for the murders of his wife and her lover begins a new life inside Shawshank prison. As he uses his accounting skills to navigate the institution, he forms a meaningful friendship with an older inmate and becomes admired for his integrity, resilience, and enduring hope.

movies.title: The Death of Robin Hood
movies.plot: After a life of crime and violence, a legendary outlaw is gravely injured following a battle he believed would be his last. In the care of a mysterious woman, he faces his troubled past and is offered a possible path toward salvation.

movies.title: Under Your Feet
movies.plot: A mother and her two children move into a prestigious building after gaining access through an unusual admission process and an unexpectedly affordable rent. Once settled, their lives are disrupted by three elderly neighbors living on a lower floor.

movies.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
movies.plot: Two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground during a perilous ascent of a mountain in Thailand. Surrounded by vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and dwindling options, they must fight to survive in a relentlessly dangerous situation.

movies.title: The Novices
movies.plot: Sister Agnès runs away from her convent in Brittany and seeks refuge in Paris with prostitute Mona Lisa. With absolutely no qualifications, the young novice has a hard job finding work, so Mona Lisa tries to teach her the ropes of the oldest profession of them all!

movies.title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
movies.plot: Years after a legendary conflict, the world’s last airbender discovers an ancient power that could preserve his disappearing culture. Joined by friends, he travels across the globe to find it before dangerous forces claim it, threatening a fragile peace built through enormous sacrifice.

movies.title: Supergirl
movies.plot: A troubled superhero leaves Earth and wanders the galaxy, where she reluctantly joins a young warrior seeking revenge against a ruthless enemy. Their mission becomes even more urgent when the hero’s beloved dog is poisoned, sending the unlikely pair across the stars in search of justice and a cure.

movies.title: The Avengers
movies.plot: When a powerful enemy threatens global security, an international peacekeeping agency assembles a team of extraordinary heroes. As these very different personalities struggle to work together, they must overcome their conflicts and unite to protect the world from disaster.

movies.title: Deep Water
movies.plot: After an international flight makes an emergency landing in shark-infested waters, frightened passengers must cooperate as their plane begins to sink. Divided by their differences and surrounded by predators drawn to the wreckage, the group faces a desperate fight to escape.

movies.title: Just Play Dead
movies.plot: A criminal mastermind plans to fake his death for insurance money while framing his wife’s lover. Meanwhile, his wife plots to kill him for real and claim everything, setting up a tense battle of deception, shifting plans, and deadly outmanoeuvring.

movies.title: Master of the Universe
movies.plot: A young man discovers untapped powers and faces an evil alien determined to conquer Earth and the universe. With an army at their command, the invader will stop at nothing, forcing him to fight back before the threat spreads beyond the planet.

movies.title: Animales
movies.plot: Four couples navigate desire, intimacy, and the search for authenticity as their relationships come under pressure. In their world, truth feels fragile, forcing them to question what they want and how honestly they connect with one another.

movies.title: Bury the Devil
movies.plot: A hospice nurse becomes trapped overnight with a dementia patient and starts to suspect that something far more unsettling than illness is affecting the woman. As the danger grows, she must find a way to survive an increasingly terrifying encounter.

movies.title: Avatar: Fire and Ash
movies.plot: After a devastating war and a painful family loss, a former human soldier and his partner face a new danger on Pandora: a violent Na’vi tribe shaped by fire and hardship. As their family struggles to survive, the conflict tests their bonds, beliefs, and hopes for the planet’s future.

movies.title: The Dog Stars
movies.plot: After a pandemic devastates the population, a man lives in isolation at a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a guarded gunman. A mysterious radio transmission received during a flight leads him to search for where the signal came from.

movies.title: Zootopia 2
movies.plot: After solving a major case, two rookie police partners follow a twisting mystery when a snake’s arrival unsettles the animal metropolis. Going undercover in unfamiliar parts of the city, they uncover hidden tensions while their partnership faces its toughest test yet.

movies.title: Avengers: Infinity War
movies.plot: The Avengers and their allies face a powerful intergalactic despot determined to gather six ancient artifacts and impose his will on all reality. As heroes from across the universe unite, their biggest challenge yet tests their strength, teamwork, and willingness to make difficult choices.

movies.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba Infinity Castle
movies.plot: A young demon hunter and his allies are pulled into a shifting fortress, where they confront powerful demons in a desperate struggle. As the conflict intensifies, the group faces terrifying battles and painful memories while the long-awaited final confrontation draws closer.

movies.title: The Shadow's Edge
movies.plot: Macau police call a retired tracking expert back into service when a dangerous crew of professional thieves repeatedly outsmarts modern surveillance. Working with younger officers, the veteran investigator must combine old-school observation with current technology to pursue an elusive criminal network through the city.

movies.title: Gandhari
movies.plot: After a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she refuses to remain helpless. Taking matters into her own hands, she sets out to hunt down the people responsible for the devastating loss and bring the circumstances surrounding the kidnapping into focus.

movies.title: Vixen!
movies.plot: At a remote Canadian resort, a sexually adventurous woman spends her days pursuing guests, acquaintances, and even relatives while her pilot husband is away. Her provocative behavior collides with racial hostility, unconventional relationships, and politically charged visitors, creating an outrageous blend of erotic exploitation, satire, and melodrama.

movies.title: Immortal Combat
movies.plot: History’s greatest warriors are summoned by a shadowy organization and forced into a deadly battle. As they struggle to survive, the fighters secretly plan to turn against their captors and dismantle the ruthless enterprise from within.

movies.title: Woman in the Moon
movies.plot: An Italian-American woman traveling to Sicily picks up a teenager who claims to be in trouble with some drug dealers.

movies.title: Masters of the Universe
movies.plot: After 15 years apart, a powerful sword leads a young man back to Eternia, where he finds his home devastated by a ruthless tyrant. To protect his family and restore his world, he must join trusted allies, uncover his true potential, and become the hero Eternia needs.

movies.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2
movies.plot: A former assistant returns to a struggling fashion magazine as its formidable editor faces pressure from a changing media landscape. Their uneasy reunion with a onetime rival, now leading a luxury brand, could provide the funding needed to keep the publication alive.

movies.title: Evil Dead Burn
movies.plot: After her husband's sudden death, a grieving widow turns to his estranged family, whose lineage is tied to research into demonic possession. When the relatives begin transforming into fear-feeding creatures, she must confront a terrifying threat while uncovering how her marriage may still bind her to the horrors surrounding them.

movies.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
movies.plot: After stopping a previous attempt to force a royal marriage, two adventurous brothers face a new threat from a determined young heir seeking to free his imprisoned father and restore their family legacy. Joined by familiar and new companions, they journey across the stars to stop the crusade.

movies.title: Avengers: Endgame
movies.plot: After a devastating defeat leaves the universe in ruins, the remaining heroes struggle with loss and uncertainty. As they reunite for one final mission to restore what was taken, they face enormous risks, difficult choices, and the consequences of trying to set things right.

movies.title: Interstellar
movies.plot: As Earth’s food supply collapses, a former pilot joins a group of explorers searching for a new home beyond a newly discovered wormhole. Their mission combines perilous space travel, complex cosmic phenomena, and a deeply personal struggle to protect humanity’s future while separated from family.

movies.title: The Godfather
movies.plot: A powerful crime family faces growing threats as its aging patriarch barely survives an attack. His youngest son, initially distant from the family business, becomes involved in protecting his loved ones and is drawn into a violent struggle for control.

movies.title: Soulm8te
movies.plot: After a powerful tech company acquires a small robotics firm, a grieving engineer tests an advanced AI companion. When he tries to make her truly sentient, she develops desires of her own, setting off a dangerous and increasingly violent struggle.

movies.title: Lucky Strike
movies.plot: A wounded American soldier struggles to survive behind enemy lines during the Battle of the Bulge. Using instinct, espionage skills, and a hand radio, he evades capture while trying to find his way back to his unit.

movies.title: Borderline
movies.plot: A group of rogue operatives abducts gang members and scatters them across major cities, triggering criminal chaos and exploiting public fears. As violence escalates, law enforcement races to uncover the scheme before it puts democratic institutions under even greater pressure.

movies.title: Lola's Secret
movies.plot: A young man's dreams come true when the sexy new maid seduces him. But she has a secret that leads to trouble.

movies.title: The Secret Woman
movies.plot: After learning she has a family and a powerful shipping business, a woman with amnesia returns to a wealthy, seemingly perfect life. As she investigates the reasons behind her departure, she must confront unanswered questions about her past.

movies.title: The End of Oak Street
movies.plot: After a mysterious cosmic event tears a suburban neighborhood away from familiar surroundings, a family finds itself transported to an unknown place. As the world around them becomes increasingly unrecognizable, they must rely on one another and stay united to survive.

movies.title: Michael
movies.plot: A gifted young performer rises from a demanding family environment to become a globally celebrated entertainer. The story follows his early musical success, life away from the stage, creative ambitions, personal struggles, and landmark performances as he pursues an extraordinary career.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
movies.plot: After reconnecting with a close friend, a Brooklyn teenager with spider-like abilities is pulled into a sprawling multiverse of heroes. When the protectors disagree over how to confront a dangerous new threat, he must challenge their rules and fight to protect the people he loves.

movies.title: The Dark Knight
movies.plot: Batman joins forces with a police lieutenant and a determined public official to dismantle Gotham’s criminal organizations. Their progress is threatened when a rising criminal mastermind unleashes a campaign of chaos, forcing Batman to confront difficult choices about justice, fear, and the limits of heroism.

movies.title: Prison on Fire
movies.plot: A veteran inmate takes a newcomer under his wing inside a harsh prison system. Together, they face violent fellow prisoners and corrupt wardens while trying to survive an environment shaped by intimidation, shifting loyalties, and abuse of power.

movies.title: Obex
movies.plot: A secluded man’s quiet life with his dog is disrupted when she disappears after he starts playing a mysterious new computer game. As reality and the game begin to blur, he enters its strange world to search for her and confront what lies beyond his isolation.

movies.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
movies.plot: A young mother raising her daughter in the house where she grew up discovers she can enter a mysterious otherworldly realm. There, she possesses a dangerous ability to bring entities from that realm into the real world, forcing her to confront an escalating supernatural threat.

movies.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
movies.plot: A disillusioned former mercenary is pulled back into action when his homeworld faces an existential threat. To protect it, he reluctantly teams up with a battle-weary Wolverine, sending the mismatched pair into a chaotic adventure filled with danger, irreverent humor, and unexpected encounters.

movies.title: The Last House
movies.plot: A family is suddenly sealed inside their home, where dwindling resources and an ominous outside threat test their ability to stay united. As isolation deepens, they must confront fear, dependence on technology, and the uncertain limits of the place meant to protect them.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
movies.plot: A Brooklyn teenager struggling with school, family, and his place in the world is bitten by a radioactive spider and gains extraordinary powers. When a dangerous experiment disrupts reality, spider-powered heroes from other dimensions arrive, forcing him to confront his fears and discover what it truly means to become a hero.

movies.title: Spider-Man
movies.plot: After a genetically altered spider bite gives a shy high school student extraordinary abilities, he begins discovering what it means to become a hero. As he navigates newfound powers, personal responsibility, and danger threatening his city, he faces a formidable enemy while trying to protect the people he cares about.

movies.title: Insidious
movies.plot: A family is shaken when their young son inexplicably falls into an endless sleep, while unsettling events begin disturbing their home. Seeking professional help, they uncover a frightening connection between the boy’s condition and the supernatural forces surrounding them.

movies.title: Toy Story
movies.plot: A beloved cowboy toy faces an unexpected challenge when a flashy space-themed newcomer becomes the favorite in a child’s room. After rivalry separates them from their owner, the two must work together through a lively adventure, learning about friendship, loyalty, and accepting change.

movies.title: Shelter
movies.plot: A man living alone on a remote island rescues a young girl during a violent storm. When the rescue exposes his hidden past, he must leave his secluded life and protect her from dangerous forces closing in.

movies.title: I Want Your Sex
movies.plot: A recent graduate takes an exciting job assisting a provocative erotic artist, who chooses him as her sexual muse. Their uninhibited relationship draws him into a confusing world of desire, control, obsession and betrayal, while strained loyalties and troubling suspicions threaten to unravel his life.

movies.title: Barreda
movies.plot: A fictionalized crime drama follows an unassuming dentist whose shocking violence against members of his family sparks a national scandal. As he presents himself as a victim, the case draws intense media attention and raises difficult questions about public fascination, gender, and the treatment of victims.

movies.title: Your Heart Will Be Broken
movies.plot: A high school student facing bullying at a new school makes a deal with the main bully: he will pretend to be her boyfriend and protect her, while she follows his rules. As their arrangement grows more complicated, real feelings emerge and pressure from family and classmates threatens their relationship.

movies.title: The Hanged Woman
movies.plot: After a singer-songwriter dies in the garden of the man she loved, her ghost remains in his mansion. Refusing to be ignored, she sets out to confront him, drawing his family into an increasingly terrifying nightmare.

movies.title: Big Baby
movies.plot: A horror screenwriter draws inspiration from nightmares about a maniac wearing a baby mask. As disturbing visions and real-life terror begin to blur together, he struggles to maintain control of his writing, his grasp on reality, and the threat surrounding potential victims.

movies.title: Oppenheimer
movies.plot: During World War II, a brilliant physicist leads a secret team of scientists in developing the atomic bomb. As the project transforms global history, he faces the personal, political, and moral consequences of helping create a weapon whose power may be impossible to control.

movies.title: Top Gun: Maverick
movies.plot: After decades as a celebrated Navy pilot, a veteran instructor is called back to train a new group of elite aviators for an exceptionally dangerous mission. As the team prepares, he must confront his past while earning the trust of pilots whose lives depend on his guidance.

movies.title: Hoppers
movies.plot: A determined animal lover discovers technology that can place human consciousness into lifelike robotic animals. Using it to understand wildlife from the inside, she becomes involved in a struggle to protect a threatened natural habitat from an expanding road project.

movies.title: Captain America: Brave New World
movies.plot: After meeting with a newly elected U.S. president, a new Captain America becomes caught in an international crisis. As tensions rise between nations, he investigates a dangerous global conspiracy and races to uncover who is manipulating events before the world is pushed toward catastrophe.

movies.title: Buddy
movies.plot: A magical orange unicorn hosts a children’s television show while holding its young cast captive inside a surreal world. As the cheerful lessons grow increasingly disturbing, the children begin questioning their reality and searching for a way to survive their demented host.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
movies.plot: After joining a major superhero battle, a teenage hero tries to balance school, friendships, and everyday life with stopping crime in Queens. Eager to prove himself, he faces a dangerous new threat while learning that being a hero requires more than advanced technology and thrilling adventures.

movies.title: Inception
movies.plot: A skilled thief who infiltrates dreams to steal secrets is offered a chance to return to his former life by completing an almost impossible job: planting an idea in someone’s subconscious. To succeed, he assembles a team and navigates increasingly complex layers of dreams.

movies.title: Jackass: Best and Last
movies.plot: A longtime stunt-comedy crew reunites for one final round of outrageous challenges, painful pranks, and reckless physical antics. Their last crusade leans into the familiar mix of group camaraderie, crude humor, and staged chaos that has defined the franchise.

movies.title: Motor City
movies.plot: In 1970s Detroit, a Vietnam veteran falls for a gangster’s girlfriend, only to be imprisoned for a crime he did not commit. After losing his freedom and the life he hoped to build, he begins plotting an escape and a relentless path toward revenge.

movies.title: Women Hell Song: Shakuhachi Benten
movies.plot: The roaming outlaw Okayo, also known as Benten due to the prominent tattoo of the Buddhist Goddess of Love emblazoned across her back. On the run from her persecutors, who seek to claim the tattoo and its skin canvas as a bounty, Okayo finds a safe haven in the arms of the mysterious shakuhachi (bamboo flute) playing Seigaku, himself tattooed with the image of Kisshoten, the Goddess of Prosperity.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
movies.plot: Harry, Ron and Hermione race to destroy the remaining magical objects sustaining Voldemort’s power while the wizarding world faces its greatest threat. Their search leads them back to Hogwarts, where friends and defenders prepare for a dangerous confrontation that will test their courage, loyalty and determination.

movies.title: Avatar
movies.plot: In the 22nd century, a paraplegic Marine travels to Pandora for a mission involving an alien civilization. As he explores the moon and grows closer to its inhabitants, he faces a difficult choice between obeying orders and protecting their home.

movies.title: Titanic
movies.plot: Decades after the Titanic’s voyage, an elderly woman recalls boarding the ship as a young woman with her mother and fiancé. Her life changes when she meets a free-spirited passenger from a very different social class, as romance unfolds against the looming danger surrounding the ship’s first and final voyage.

movies.title: Kraken
movies.plot: A marine biologist researching a fish farm encounters a series of strange events near a deep fjord. After two teenagers die violently, the investigation points toward something hidden beneath the water, forcing her to confront a threat that may be far larger than expected.

movies.title: Nightborn
movies.plot: In a Finnish forest, new parents begin a fresh chapter together, but the mother’s happiness is overshadowed by a chilling suspicion about their newborn. As she struggles alone with what she believes may be true, the growing secrecy places their relationship under strain.

movies.title: Desire
movies.plot: A wealthy woman whose family life appears perfect becomes consumed by dissatisfaction after a young swimming coach enters her world. Their secret relationship fuels desire and jealousy, while tensions between a mother and daughter create a dangerous emotional triangle that threatens the stability she has built.

movies.title: Between the Sheets
movies.plot: A woman takes a man she just met at a nightclub to a hotel, so they can have a one-night stand, but things start to get complicated when he asks her to spend the night with him so they can have a chance to know about each other between the sheets.

movies.title: Mortal Kombat II
movies.plot: A group of battle-hardened champions, joined by a reluctant movie star, must confront a ruthless conqueror whose rule threatens Earthrealm and its defenders. Their dangerous mission leads to a brutal fantasy showdown filled with rivalries, powerful fighters, and no-holds-barred combat.

movies.title: The Furious
movies.plot: When a criminal network kidnaps a father’s daughter and corrupt police refuse to help, he begins a desperate search on his own. A determined journalist, whose wife has also vanished, joins him, and together they fight through a dangerous underworld driven by grief, anger, and the need to bring their loved ones home.

movies.title: Lilo & Stitch
movies.plot: A lonely Hawaiian girl adopts a mischievous alien who is hiding from authorities. As the unlikely pair grow closer, their chaotic adventures bring new energy to her fragile family and create a heartfelt story about belonging, love, and acceptance.

movies.title: Leviticus
movies.plot: Two teenage boys flee a violent entity that can take the form of the person each desires most. As they struggle to survive, their escape becomes entangled with fear, longing, and the oppressive isolation of rural Australia.

movies.title: The Matrix
movies.plot: In a dystopian future, a computer hacker discovers that everyday reality may be an elaborate digital illusion controlled by powerful machines. After joining underground rebels, he must learn the rules of this hidden world and decide how far he is willing to go to help free humanity.

movies.title: Monsters, Inc.
movies.plot: In a monster city powered by children's screams, a top scarer and his wisecracking partner face chaos when a little girl enters their world. As they try to keep her hidden and return her home, their assumptions about children—and their own workplace—are challenged.

movies.title: Kung Fu Soccer
movies.plot: A women’s soccer team enters a major tournament facing highly skilled opponents, intense outside pressure, and increasingly complicated plays on the field. To overcome the odds, the players must draw on their martial arts abilities and find a way to change the course of the competition.

movies.title: The Priest: Thanksgiving Massacre
movies.plot: A family gathers for Thanksgiving at an isolated cabin, unaware of its horrific history. As a murderous priest returns, the celebration becomes a fight for survival against a violent threat connected to the site’s past.

movies.title: The Invite
movies.plot: A strained married couple invites their enigmatic upstairs neighbors to dinner, hoping the evening might ease their growing distance. Instead, four people find themselves confronting uncomfortable truths about love, communication, attraction, and the complicated state of their relationships during an increasingly revealing night.

movies.title: The Sheep Detectives
movies.plot: A shepherd reads detective novels to his sheep each night, never suspecting they understand every word. When a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the flock follows clues, studies human suspects, and uses its unusual perspective to investigate what happened.

movies.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
movies.plot: In a vibrant retro-futuristic world, a super-powered family balances public heroism with the demands of an expanding family. When a mysterious herald warns that a ravenous space god threatens Earth, the team must confront an impossible choice while searching for a way to protect both their loved ones and humanity.

movies.title: Salitan
movies.plot: A suspicious wife follows her husband while traveling in Bali and meets a charming man who captures her attention. As their relationship develops, she begins wishing her husband would truly have an affair, hoping it might ease the guilt surrounding her own choices.

movies.title: Being 14
movies.plot: The lives and turbulent adventures of a bunch of fourteen-year-old teenagers, through the eyes of three young girls - Sarah, Jade and Louise - with one last year to go before high school.

movies.title: Dune: Part One
movies.plot: A gifted young heir leaves his home with his family for Arrakis, a dangerous desert world that holds the empire’s most valuable resource. As rival forces move against them, he must confront fear, political conflict, and troubling visions of a destiny he does not yet understand.

movies.title: Dune: Part Two
movies.plot: A young nobleman joins the desert-dwelling Fremen on Arrakis, seeking revenge against those who destroyed his family. As he grows closer to a fierce warrior and becomes a possible leader, he must weigh personal love against a dangerous vision of the future.

movies.title: Jurassic World: Rebirth
movies.plot: Five years after the previous adventure, a covert team travels to an isolated island to collect genetic material from three enormous dinosaurs. Their mission becomes more dangerous when they encounter a stranded family and uncover a disturbing secret hidden there for decades.

movies.title: In the Grey
movies.plot: A covert team of elite operatives emerges from the shadows to recover a billion-dollar fortune stolen by a ruthless despot. Their seemingly impossible heist becomes a deadly contest of strategy, deception, and survival, demanding meticulous preparation before the operation erupts into relentless action.

movies.title: The Imitation Game
movies.plot: During World War II, a brilliant but isolated mathematician joins a secret team racing to break Germany’s seemingly unbreakable code. As pressure mounts, their work could change the course of the war, while the mathematician faces deep personal and social challenges in a country that does not accept him.

movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
movies.plot: As armies gather for a decisive war, a reluctant heir must unite the forces of good while a brave hobbit and his loyal companion undertake a perilous journey into the enemy’s land. Their mission offers the only hope of destroying a powerful ring and saving their world.

movies.title: Iron Man
movies.plot: After being captured in Afghanistan, a billionaire weapons engineer is forced to build a powerful device for his captors. The experience changes his perspective, leading him to create a high-tech suit of armor and use his abilities to confront dangerous forces.

movies.title: Spider-Man 3
movies.plot: A celebrated superhero faces several dangerous threats, including a shape-shifting criminal and a rival who becomes linked to a powerful alien organism. As the hero’s abilities and behavior change, he must also navigate strained friendships, romantic complications, and difficult choices about revenge and forgiveness.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
movies.plot: During a young wizard’s second year at a magical school, a house-elf delivers a troubling warning before mysterious attacks spread through the halls. With students in danger and an ancient secret threatening the school, the young wizard and two close friends must follow clues, face frightening creatures, and rely on courage and magic.

movies.title: The Lion King
movies.plot: A young lion prince dreams of becoming king while growing up under his father’s guidance. When his uncle schemes for the throne, the cub faces betrayal, loss, and exile before beginning a journey toward responsibility and his rightful place.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
movies.plot: An orphaned boy living with unkind relatives discovers on his eleventh birthday that he is a powerful wizard. Sent to a magical boarding school, he makes close friends, learns to control his abilities, and begins investigating the mystery surrounding his parents and a dangerous figure from the past.

movies.title: Fight Club
movies.plot: An insomniac office worker meets a charismatic soap salesman who offers a radical escape from consumer culture. Together, they create an underground fighting group that spreads rapidly, drawing in frustrated men and pushing their rebellion toward increasingly dangerous consequences.

movies.title: Elize: Shadows of a Woman
movies.plot: A former escort discovers that her wealthy husband has been unfaithful, sending their marriage into a painful struggle with betrayal, distrust, and emotional turmoil. Inspired by a real case, the film explores how infidelity can reshape a relationship and the people caught within it.

movies.title: The Soldier with Great Maneuvers
movies.plot: Doctor Eva Marini takes up a position at an army base to investigate the sexual behavior of the Italian male soldier and soon finds out she's taken on more than she bargained for.

movies.title: The Batman
movies.plot: In his second year as a crime-fighter, a brooding vigilante investigates a series of murders in Gotham City. Working with a police ally and a mysterious thief, he uncovers corruption reaching into the city’s powerful circles and is forced to reconsider what his mission truly means.

movies.title: Swapped
movies.plot: A small woodland creature and a majestic bird, natural enemies in their valley, magically swap places and begin an adventure to return to normal. Along the way, they discover a serious threat that could endanger their species and the entire valley they call home.

movies.title: The Wild Robot
movies.plot: After a shipwreck, an intelligent robot is stranded on an uninhabited island. As the robot learns to survive among wary animals, it forms an unexpected bond with an orphaned baby goose and discovers new responsibilities, challenges, and connections in the natural world.

movies.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
movies.plot: When an attempt to create a peacekeeping program goes wrong, a team of powerful heroes faces a dangerous artificial intelligence determined to threaten the planet. As the crisis grows, the heroes must overcome tensions, form uneasy alliances, and confront a global challenge together.

movies.title: Zootopia
movies.plot: A determined young rabbit becomes the first of her kind to join a city police force, but proving herself is harder than expected. When mammals begin disappearing, she reluctantly teams up with a clever fox to investigate the case and uncover tensions threatening the city’s peaceful society.

movies.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
movies.plot: A lonely high-school student investigating his family’s past is transformed by a mysterious spider bite. As he learns to control his new abilities, he balances romance, personal loss, and the growing threat posed by a scientist’s dangerous experiment.

movies.title: Up
movies.plot: A widowed older man fulfills a lifelong dream by lifting his home with balloons and traveling toward a distant South American destination. A young wilderness scout accidentally joins him, and together they encounter unusual wildlife, talking dogs, and unexpected challenges along the way.

movies.title: Toy Story 3
movies.plot: As their longtime owner prepares to leave for college, a beloved group of toys faces an uncertain future after being mistakenly sent to a daycare center. What first seems like a fresh start becomes a dangerous situation, forcing them to work together on an escape and confront the challenge of moving on.

movies.title: Believers
movies.plot: On a remote island near Japan, three members of a strict cult follow a program intended to free them from modern society and purify their minds. As isolation deepens, two members struggle against their vows and the desires they were meant to suppress.

movies.title: One Battle After Another
movies.plot: A washed-up former revolutionary lives off-grid with his spirited teenage daughter, trying to escape the consequences of his past. When a dangerous enemy resurfaces and the girl goes missing, he sets out to find her, drawing on old allies while father and daughter face a turbulent world shaped by political conflict.

movies.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
movies.plot: Still grieving a painful loss, a spacefaring hero must reunite the Guardians for a dangerous mission when one of their own is critically injured. As the team races across the galaxy for a possible cure, they confront buried memories, powerful enemies, and what family truly means.

movies.title: War Machine
movies.plot: During his final mission in Army Ranger training, a combat engineer takes charge of a struggling unit as they face a giant otherworldly killing machine. Forced to rely on endurance, quick thinking, and teamwork, he leads the group through a brutal fight for survival.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Far from Home
movies.plot: A teenager and his classmates head to Europe for a summer trip, but their plans change when a senior agent asks him to investigate mysterious creatures linked to natural disasters across the continent. As the danger grows, he must balance superhero responsibilities with school, friendship, and first love.

movies.title: Superman
movies.plot: A journalist in Metropolis balances his life as a powerful alien hero with the human upbringing that shaped his values. As he faces a world marked by political tension, public distrust, and powerful opponents, he must decide how to remain hopeful while protecting the people around him.

movies.title: Insidious: The Red Door
movies.plot: A father and his college-aged son try to repair their strained relationship while disturbing memories and supernatural visions return. As they confront a sinister red door and the dangers beyond it, both must face their family's troubled past and the forces connected to it.

movies.title: Captain America: Civil War
movies.plot: After devastating battles raise questions about accountability, governments seek authority over superhuman missions. The proposal divides the Avengers, with one faction supporting official oversight and another defending independence, while a fugitive linked to a founding hero’s past intensifies the conflict between former allies.

movies.title: Coco
movies.plot: Despite his family’s ban on music, a young boy dreams of becoming a musician. A mysterious chain of events transports him to the colorful Land of the Dead, where he teams up with a charming trickster to uncover the truth about his family’s history and find his way home.

movies.title: WALL·E
movies.plot: On a deserted Earth buried under waste, a solitary cleanup robot discovers a new sense of purpose after meeting an advanced probe. Their connection leads them from the planet to a vast spacecraft, where their journey could affect humanity’s future.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
movies.plot: After the death of a beloved mentor, three young wizards leave school behind to find and destroy magical objects tied to an immortal dark lord. Hunted by his followers and forced into hiding, they face danger, isolation, and growing pressure as their friendship is tested.

movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
movies.plot: A young hobbit inherits a mysterious ring and must leave his peaceful home to keep it from a powerful evil force. Joined by a diverse fellowship of companions, he begins a perilous journey across Middle-earth toward the only place where the ring can be destroyed.

movies.title: Pulp Fiction
movies.plot: Several criminals, a gangster’s restless companion, and a boxer whose career is fading become connected through a series of dangerous, darkly comic episodes. Told in a playful, out-of-order structure, the film follows their tense encounters, unexpected complications, and sharply observed conversations across Los Angeles.

movies.title: Practical Magic
movies.plot: Two sisters from a family with magical traditions try to live ordinary lives while facing a curse surrounding love. After an abusive boyfriend dies unexpectedly, they turn to magic and attract the attention of a suspicious local detective, leading to a dangerous struggle involving a restless spirit and their family’s future.

movies.title: Vishwanath and Sons
movies.plot: An acclaimed professional handgunner in his 40s, driven by fame and wealth, encounters a woman in her 20s named Maddy. Their connection creates emotional and personal challenges, forcing both to confront the complications of their dynamic.

movies.title: Rita
movies.plot: A lonely wife remains behind while her husband works abroad, and both seek comfort and sexual fulfillment elsewhere. When he returns, they try to carry on as if nothing happened, forcing their marriage to confront questions of desire, honesty, silence, and whether love can survive hidden choices.

movies.title: Graphic Desires
movies.plot: When reclusive Franklin cheats on his partner with a mysterious girl he meets on a dating app, it becomes the start of a deadly obsession.

movies.title: The Housemaid
movies.plot: Trying to rebuild her life, a woman accepts a live-in housemaid position with a wealthy family. The dream opportunity soon becomes a tense maze of suspicion, attraction, and hidden power, as troubling behavior inside the seemingly perfect home makes her question whom she can trust.

movies.title: Thunderbolts*
movies.plot: After being trapped in a deadly situation, a group of troubled outcasts must work together on a dangerous mission. As tensions rise, they confront painful memories, personal struggles, and the difficult question of whether they can become something more than their pasts.

movies.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
movies.plot: A veteran operative and his team race to stop a terrifying artificial intelligence that has infiltrated intelligence networks worldwide. Hunted by governments and a mysterious figure from the past, they seek the means to shut it down before it changes the world forever.

movies.title: The Wrecking Crew
movies.plot: After their estranged father dies under mysterious circumstances, two half-brothers reunite in Hawaii to seek answers. A hot-headed detective and a disciplined military man must put aside their differences as their investigation uncovers buried family secrets and a conspiracy that threatens their loved ones and local communities.

movies.title: Fall
movies.plot: Two best friends set out to conquer their fears by climbing a remote, abandoned radio tower. When they become stranded at the top with little hope of getting down, they must rely on their skills and resourcefulness to survive the elements, dwindling supplies, and terrifying heights.

movies.title: GOAT
movies.plot: A small goat with big dreams gets a rare chance to join the professional roarball league, a fast, full-contact sport dominated by larger, tougher animals. Facing skepticism from his new teammates and the pressure of competing at the highest level, he must prove that determination and teamwork can matter more than size.

movies.title: Coraline
movies.plot: In a dull new home, a curious young girl discovers a hidden passage leading to a dazzling version of her family life. What first seems perfect gradually becomes frightening, forcing her to confront danger and value what she has.

movies.title: Spirited Away
movies.plot: A young girl is pulled into a mysterious spirit world after her parents undergo a strange transformation. To save her family and find a way home, she must find work, navigate an unfamiliar bathhouse, and discover courage, trust, and compassion.

movies.title: Seven
movies.plot: Two homicide detectives investigate a series of gruesome murders modeled on the seven deadly sins. A seasoned investigator studies the killer’s pattern while his impatient rookie partner pushes forward, forcing them to confront a case that grows darker and more disturbing with every clue.

movies.title: Forrest Gump
movies.plot: A kind-hearted Alabama man with below-average intelligence moves through childhood, military service, fame, and unexpected success while remaining remarkably sincere. As he encounters major moments in American history, he stays focused on loyalty, friendship, and his enduring feelings for a childhood companion.

movies.title: Jungle
movies.plot: In 1981, an adventurous young traveler joins two friends and a guide on a journey into a remote rainforest. Their search for a hidden village becomes a harrowing fight for survival as the group faces dangerous terrain, dwindling resources, and the darker side of human nature.

movies.title: The Devil's Mouth
movies.plot: A group of college friends on a Thailand adventure become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen dwindles, mounting danger and old tensions test their ability to work together and survive the perilous underwater maze.

movies.title: Dhamaal 4
movies.plot: A group of fun-loving friends reunites for another treasure hunt, chasing the legendary Treasure of Life. Their journey brings a series of ridiculous challenges, comic mishaps, and chaotic detours as they try to stay together and reach the prize.

movies.title: Svodish s uma
movies.plot: A young woman moves into a spacious apartment where a mirror begins revealing a parallel version of the same home. There, a carefree young man lives instead of her, drawing the two strangers into a fantastical romance as they search for a way to connect their separate worlds.

movies.title: The Sparrow's Fluttering
movies.plot: A woman, who has been the mistress of a man who has just died, thinks about leaving the little Italian village where they lived and moving to another place. An old and rich man offers her a place in his house, however, she will have to listen to him telling his past love stories.

movies.title: Parasite
movies.plot: An unemployed family sees a chance to improve their lives by entering the household of a wealthy family through a series of carefully arranged jobs. Their scheme initially brings opportunity and comedy, but growing complications place both families in an increasingly tense situation.

movies.title: Joker
movies.plot: In 1980s Gotham City, a struggling comedian faces isolation, hardship, and growing hostility from the world around him. As his efforts to connect and find purpose repeatedly fail, he begins a disturbing transformation that draws him toward crime, violence, and a darker public identity.

movies.title: Crime 101
movies.plot: An elusive thief planning one last high-stakes robbery along Los Angeles’ 101 freeway finds his plans complicated by an insurance broker facing her own difficult choices. Meanwhile, a determined detective studies the pattern of the heists and closes in, while another dangerous criminal raises the pressure.

movies.title: Whiplash
movies.plot: A gifted young drummer at an elite music school pursues greatness under a terrifying instructor who demands perfection. As the pressure intensifies, the drummer must decide how much of his health, relationships, and humanity he is willing to sacrifice for success.

movies.title: The Conjuring
movies.plot: A family moves into a remote farmhouse and soon faces frightening supernatural disturbances. When paranormal investigators arrive to help, they uncover a deeply troubling presence and must work to protect the family from an escalating threat.

movies.title: Fury
movies.plot: In April 1945, a battle-hardened army sergeant leads a five-person Sherman tank crew on a dangerous mission behind enemy lines. As the Allies make their final push, a rookie soldier joins the crew and faces the brutal realities of combat and survival.

movies.title: Big Hero 6
movies.plot: A gifted teenager and an inflatable healthcare robot form a close bond after a devastating loss. Joined by a group of inventive friends, they use their talents and upgraded technology to become high-tech heroes while investigating a mysterious threat in their futuristic city.

movies.title: Iron Man 2
movies.plot: With his identity as an armored superhero now public, a billionaire inventor faces pressure from the government, the media, and rivals seeking his technology. As his health and legacy complicate his choices, he must rely on trusted allies while confronting a dangerous new threat and expanding the reach of his armored suits.

movies.title: The Devil Wears Prada
movies.plot: A young Midwestern woman moves to New York hoping to become a writer, but instead lands an assistant job at a major fashion magazine. Working for a demanding, intimidating editor, she enters a glamorous, high-pressure world that challenges her priorities, relationships, and sense of self.

movies.title: Citizen Vigilante
movies.plot: A wealthy expatriate takes justice into his own hands, hunting criminals while building a following on social media. His increasingly public crusade brings him into conflict with the local police chief and raises questions about the limits of vigilantism.

movies.title: The Green Mile
movies.plot: On death row in a Southern prison, a compassionate guard encounters a gentle giant with a mysterious gift for healing. As the guard learns more about the condemned man, he faces difficult questions about justice, mercy, and whether the execution can be prevented.

movies.title: Gladiator
movies.plot: After a revered ruler dies, his ambitious son seizes power and strips a loyal general of his rank. Forced into slavery and trained as a gladiator, the once-respected soldier must survive brutal arena battles while confronting a corrupt empire and fighting to reclaim his honor.

movies.title: Insidious: The Last Key
movies.plot: A paranormal investigator and her team travel to a small New Mexico town to examine a reported haunting. The case becomes deeply personal when she discovers that the home at its center was once her family’s house, forcing her to confront a frightening chapter from her past.

movies.title: Greenland 2: Migration
movies.plot: After surviving the comet’s devastation inside a Greenland bunker, a family leaves relative safety behind. They cross the ruined landscape of Europe, facing dangerous conditions and uncertain encounters as they search for a place where humanity might begin again.

movies.title: The Terminator
movies.plot: In a bleak future ruled by machines, a nearly unstoppable cyborg is sent back to 1984 to hunt a young woman whose unborn child could change humanity’s fate. A battle-scarred soldier follows from the future to protect her, forcing them into a desperate fight for survival.

movies.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
movies.plot: A reprogrammed cyborg travels back in time to protect a young boy from an advanced shape-shifting machine sent to kill him. Joined by the boy’s determined mother, they race to prevent a future nuclear catastrophe while confronting questions about fate, humanity, and whether the future can be changed.

movies.title: The Drama
movies.plot: A happily engaged couple sees their wedding week unravel after an unexpected confession shakes their relationship and unsettles their closest friends. As the fallout grows, they confront difficult questions about trust, judgment, forgiveness, and whether love can survive an uncomfortable truth.

movies.title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
movies.plot: After a young girl vanishes into the desert, her devastated family spends years living with the loss. When she unexpectedly returns, their hoped-for reunion becomes a terrifying struggle as unsettling signs suggest she may not be the same child who disappeared.

movies.title: Sinners
movies.plot: Twin brothers return to their hometown hoping to start over by opening a new gathering place, but their plans are threatened when a powerful evil arrives. As the night unfolds, the brothers and their community must confront danger, temptation, and forces tied to the music that brings them together.

movies.title: Now You See Me: Now You Don't
movies.plot: A veteran team of illusionists reunites with three younger performers to target a powerful diamond heiress whose criminal empire is built on money laundering and trafficking. To steal a valuable diamond from a heavily protected location, the divided magicians must overcome their differences and attempt their most ambitious heist yet.

movies.title: Frozen II
movies.plot: A young queen and her sister leave their kingdom with friends to investigate an ancient mystery in a distant forest. Along the way, they face dangerous natural forces, uncover hidden truths about the past, and confront difficult questions about family, change, responsibility, and growing up.

movies.title: KPop Demon Hunters
movies.plot: Three K-pop superstars fill stadiums by day and secretly protect their fans from supernatural threats. Balancing demanding pop careers with dangerous battles, the performers must work together as a team while facing challenges that test their courage, friendship, and sense of self.

movies.title: Venom: The Last Dance
movies.plot: A fugitive and his alien symbiote partner are pursued by human forces and deadly creatures from another world. As their enemies close in and a powerful threat endangers more than their own survival, the pair must confront difficult choices while trying to stay together.

movies.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
movies.plot: A young superhero balances protecting the city with his complicated relationship and the promise to keep his distance. His life becomes more difficult when a powerful new villain appears, an old friend returns, and clues about his family raise fresh questions about the past.

movies.title: My Fault
movies.plot: A proud, independent teenager leaves her old life behind to move into her mother’s wealthy new husband’s mansion. There, she meets her new stepbrother, and their opposing personalities quickly create tension, attraction, and complicated family dynamics.

movies.title: The Departed
movies.plot: A police department sends an officer undercover to infiltrate a powerful crime syndicate, while the gang places its own informant inside the department. As both sides search for the mole among them, two men living double lives face mounting danger, distrust, and pressure.

movies.title: Finding Nemo
movies.plot: A curious young fish is taken from his ocean home to an aquarium, leaving his anxious father determined to find him. Along the way, the father is joined by a friendly, forgetful companion, while the young fish works with his new tank mates to seek a way back to the sea.

movies.title: The Incredible Hulk
movies.plot: A scientist on the run searches for a cure to the uncontrollable force of rage inside him. When military forces pursue him and seek to exploit his abilities, he returns to civilization and faces a dangerous new opponent.

movies.title: Schindler's List
movies.plot: During World War II, a wealthy businessman opens a factory in occupied Poland, initially seeking profit through wartime connections. As persecution intensifies, he gradually risks his fortune and safety to protect Jewish workers from Nazi brutality and deportation.

movies.title: Ice Age: Collision Course
movies.plot: An acorn-obsessed rodent accidentally triggers cosmic events that send a dangerous threat toward Earth. As the planet faces upheaval, a mismatched herd leaves home and travels through strange new places, searching for a way to protect their families and survive the adventure.

movies.title: Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope
movies.plot: When a princess is captured by an oppressive galactic regime, a restless farm boy joins forces with a charming captain and two quirky droids. Guided by an old guardian, they embark on a daring rescue mission that could help restore freedom and justice across the galaxy.

movies.title: Alien
movies.plot: A commercial spaceship crew investigates a distress signal from a distant planet and discovers a chamber filled with mysterious eggs. After one crew member is attacked, an alien threat is brought aboard, turning the ship’s confined corridors into a terrifying fight for survival.

movies.title: Stepdaddy
movies.plot: Two sisters become involved in separate passionate relationships with their stepfather, creating a taboo family situation filled with emotional conflict and intrigue. The story focuses on forbidden attraction, complicated loyalties, and the tension that arises when private affairs collide within the same household.

movies.title: School on Fire
movies.plot: A young schoolgirl, Yuen Fong becomes caught in a tragic stranglehold of triad activity after she testifies in court over a triad beating. When this news reaches the triad leader Brother Smart, Yuen Fong must pay him protection money for what she has done as events begin to escalate.

movies.title: Country Hooker
movies.plot: A couple of musicians are on their way to a show at a country bar. Along the way, they pick up a couple of sexy hitchhiking ladies and decide to pull over for a pitstop. Eventually, they make it to the bar and uncover that the deep voiced country singer that also plays there is also a pimp who uses the "waitresses" to make him some extra cash. It is up to our musician heroes to put an end to the singer and his operation.

movies.title: Avatar: The Way of Water
movies.plot: More than a decade after the earlier conflict, a family living on Pandora faces renewed danger and leaves its forest home in search of safety. Among a reef-dwelling community, they must adapt to unfamiliar customs and environments while protecting one another from threats that follow them.

movies.title: F1: The Movie
movies.plot: A retired racing legend is drawn back into Formula 1 to help rescue a struggling team and mentor its promising young driver. As they face fierce competition, team pressures, and the demands of life at high speed, the veteran must decide how far he is willing to go for another shot at glory.

movies.title: Chainsaw Man - The Movie: Reze Arc
movies.plot: A young devil hunter’s routine changes when a mysterious girl enters his life, drawing him into a dangerous mix of romance, deception, and brutal battles. As devils, hunters, and hidden enemies collide, he must decide whom to trust while fighting to survive.

movies.title: The Gorge
movies.plot: Two highly trained operatives are assigned to guard opposite sides of a mysterious gorge, communicating across the distance as an unexpected connection grows. When a dangerous force emerges from below, they must put aside their separation and work together to survive the threats within.

movies.title: Inside Out 2
movies.plot: A teenager’s mind is disrupted by puberty as new emotions arrive and challenge the established team. While preparing for an important hockey camp and trying to fit in with new peers, she faces social pressure, changing friendships, and an increasingly complicated sense of who she wants to be.

movies.title: Logan
movies.plot: In the near future, a weary mutant cares for an ailing mentor while hiding on the Mexican border. Their fragile routine is disrupted when a young mutant arrives, pursued by dangerous forces, forcing them into a violent journey that challenges their isolation and offers a chance at protection and hope.

movies.title: Hacksaw Ridge
movies.plot: During World War II, a devout American medic joins the Army but refuses to carry or use a weapon. Facing hostility during training and the terrifying realities of battle, he remains committed to saving wounded soldiers while serving at Okinawa’s Hacksaw Ridge.

movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
movies.plot: A divided fellowship follows separate paths as a ring-bearer and his companion journey toward a deadly land, while three allies search for captured friends and help defend a threatened kingdom. Meanwhile, a corrupt wizard gathers a vast army, pushing the realm toward a decisive battle.

movies.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
movies.plot: When a ruthless pirate seizes a legendary ship and kidnaps a governor’s daughter, a blacksmith teams up with an unpredictable pirate to rescue her. Their pursuit leads them into a dangerous supernatural mystery involving a cursed crew, forcing the unlikely allies to face peril on land and sea.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
movies.plot: A young wizard returns to Hogwarts for a dangerous school year after a notorious prisoner escapes from a feared wizarding prison. As mysterious creatures and troubling threats surround the castle, he and his friends uncover secrets connected to the past while facing growing danger.

movies.title: Insidious: Chapter 3
movies.plot: Before the Lambert family haunting, a retired psychic reluctantly agrees to help a teenage girl who hopes to contact her dead mother. When a dangerous supernatural entity targets the girl, the psychic must confront her own fears and return to the spirit world.

movies.title: Shrek
movies.plot: A reclusive ogre’s peaceful swamp is overrun by banished fairy-tale creatures. To reclaim his home, he sets out with a talkative donkey on a quest to rescue a princess from a dragon-guarded castle, encountering comic adventures and unexpected lessons along the way.

movies.title: The Debt Collector
movies.plot: Haunted by past mistakes and facing a terminal diagnosis, a former debt collector returns to the criminal underworld. There, he takes on a violent organization while trying to protect the people caught in its path.

movies.title: Hope
movies.plot: In a remote South Korean village, local police investigate a mysterious creature causing chaos in the community. As fear and misunderstanding spread, tensions rise among the residents, turning an unusual disturbance into a dangerous conflict with consequences that reach far beyond the village.

movies.title: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
movies.plot: After marriage, a bride chooses to remain in her family home, leaving her husband to adjust to life with his in-laws. Their unusual domestic arrangement tests expectations about married life, family boundaries, and whether a couple can build a relationship on unfamiliar terms.

movies.title: Kesong Puti
movies.plot: A small-town cheese vendor meets a charming dairy supplier, and their immediate chemistry leads to a daring secret. As their humble product captures the community’s attention, the pair face the excitement and complications that come with turning an ordinary local trade into an unexpected sensation.

movies.title: Poppea's Hot Nights
movies.plot: Poppea's Hot Nights (Italian: Le calde notti di Poppea) is a 1969 Italian comedy film set in Ancient Rome. It was written and directed by Guido Malatesta and stars Olga Schoberová (credited as Olinka Berova) and Brad Harris in the main roles.

movies.title: The Super Mario Bros. Movie
movies.plot: Two Brooklyn plumbers are swept through a mysterious pipe into a magical world. Separated from his brother, one of them sets out across colorful kingdoms, meeting unlikely allies and facing dangerous obstacles in a quest to reunite their family.

movies.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
movies.plot: A sorcerer and his mystical allies travel through dangerous alternate realities after a young woman with extraordinary powers becomes a target. As the boundaries between universes grow more unstable, they face a mysterious adversary and confront the risks of unleashing the multiverse.

movies.title: A Minecraft Movie
movies.plot: Four misfits are pulled through a mysterious portal into the Overworld, a colorful cubic world shaped by imagination. To return home, they must learn its rules, survive its dangers, and join an unexpected expert crafter on a magical quest.

movies.title: How to Train Your Dragon
movies.plot: On a rugged island where Vikings and dragons have fought for generations, a young Viking outsider secretly befriends a feared dragon. Their growing bond challenges long-held beliefs and forces the community to reconsider its relationship with the creatures it fears.

movies.title: Inside Out
movies.plot: When an 11-year-old moves to a new city, five personified emotions try to guide her through the upheaval. After Joy and Sadness become separated from the control center, they travel through the mind’s strange, colorful landscapes to return and help restore balance.

movies.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
movies.plot: After being shot and left for dead by her former employer and fellow assassins, a woman awakens from a long coma and begins a relentless quest for revenge. Rebuilding her strength and pursuing those responsible, she travels across continents toward a series of dangerous confrontations.

movies.title: Troy
movies.plot: A Trojan prince’s romance with a Spartan queen sparks a devastating conflict between two powerful kingdoms. As a vast Greek army sails toward Troy, warriors, rulers, and families are drawn into a brutal struggle shaped by love, ambition, pride, and the pursuit of lasting glory.

movies.title: Jaws
movies.plot: When a seaside community is threatened by a dangerous great white shark, its police chief joins forces with a young marine biologist and an experienced shark hunter. Together, they set out on a perilous mission to protect the town and stop the attacks before more lives are lost.

movies.title: Yellow Eyes
movies.plot: A young couple inherits a house containing a mysterious relic inhabited by a powerful demonic spirit. When the husband becomes possessed, his wife searches for an exorcist while confronting the growing danger inside their new home.

movies.title: The Adolescent
movies.plot: In the summer of 1939, 13-year-old Marie goes with her parents to visit her grandparents in a small town near Avignon. Marie discovers her femininity and falls for a young Jewish doctor, but he prefers Eva, Marie's mother.

movies.title: Predator: Badlands
movies.plot: Cast out by his clan, a young Predator travels to a deadly planet to face a seemingly unbeatable creature. Along the way, he reluctantly teams up with a damaged android and a native creature, confronting dangerous wildlife, family expectations, and the limits of surviving alone.

movies.title: Fast X
movies.plot: A seasoned driver and his close-knit crew face a dangerous adversary driven by revenge from the past. As the threat targets everything they value, the team is pulled into a globe-spanning race involving explosive attacks, high-speed chases, daring fights, and increasingly impossible odds.

movies.title: Weapons
movies.plot: When nearly every child in one classroom vanishes from home at the same time overnight, a small community is plunged into fear and suspicion. A teacher, a grieving parent, a police officer, and the lone child left behind become connected as they search for answers amid unsettling events.

movies.title: The Substance
movies.plot: A fading celebrity turns to a black-market substance promising a younger, improved version of herself. As the two versions share time and pursue different ideas of success, pressure, jealousy, and the demand for perpetual youth push their arrangement toward increasingly disturbing consequences.

movies.title: The Dark Knight Rises
movies.plot: Years after a disgraced masked vigilante disappears, a powerful terrorist leader and a mysterious cat burglar threaten a city struggling to preserve its fragile peace. Forced back into action, the wounded hero must confront his limits, rally unexpected allies, and protect the people who once turned against him.

movies.title: Deadpool 2
movies.plot: A wisecracking mercenary tries to protect a troubled young mutant from a powerful soldier from the future. As the threat grows, he assembles an unlikely team and confronts danger while searching for purpose, family, and a way to do the right thing.

movies.title: Blade Runner 2049
movies.plot: Decades after the original events, a new blade runner uncovers a long-buried secret that could plunge a fragile society into chaos. His investigation sends him searching for a former blade runner who has been missing for thirty years, while forcing him to question identity, memory, and what it means to be human.

movies.title: Despicable Me
movies.plot: A determined supervillain plans an audacious theft of the Moon, but his scheme requires him to adopt three orphaned girls and use them as part of his plan. As they grow closer, their unexpected bond challenges his ambition and the criminal life he has always known.

A worldwide scientific warning reveals that catastrophic solar activity is destabilizing Earth, prompting global leaders to prepare hidden arks for a limited number of survivors. As earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and massive floods spread, a divorced writer races across collapsing landscapes to protect his family while humanity faces an uncertain future.

movies.title: Back to the Future
movies.plot: An eighties teenager is accidentally sent back to 1955, where he disrupts his parents’ first meeting and risks changing his own future. With help from an eccentric inventor, he must restore the timeline, bring his parents together, and find a way home.

movies.title: Yellow Mirror
movies.plot: In two darkly comic tales, a defective lamp challenges one family member’s understanding of reality, while an AI-powered tablet forms an unsettling bond with another. Together, the family searches for clarity through strange, disturbing, and bizarre circumstances.

movies.title: By Any Means
movies.plot: A young FBI agent enters 1960s Mississippi to investigate brutal killings targeting civil rights leaders. Working with a notorious mafia hitman, he is drawn into a dangerous hunt that tests the boundary between justice and vengeance.

movies.title: Ballerina
movies.plot: Set within the timeline of a previous chapter in the assassin saga, a young woman begins training in a secretive tradition that blends ballet with deadly combat. As she grows into her skills, she is drawn toward a dangerous mission of vengeance within an elaborate underworld.

movies.title: Thor: Ragnarok
movies.plot: Imprisoned far from home, a powerful warrior must race back to Asgard when a ruthless new threat endangers his world and its civilization. Along the way, he is drawn into an unexpected contest and must gather unlikely allies for the fight ahead.

movies.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
movies.plot: A New York stockbroker builds a fortune through securities fraud, lavish spending, and reckless ambition while federal investigators close in. Based on an autobiography, the film follows his rise through a world of corruption, excess, and increasingly dangerous choices.

movies.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
movies.plot: In a harsh post-apocalyptic wasteland, a solitary survivor joins forces with a determined rebel and a group of women fleeing a tyrannical ruler. Pursued across the desert by violent gangs, they fight to survive while searching for a safer future.

movies.title: Doctor Strange
movies.plot: After a career-ending accident leaves a brilliant surgeon desperate for answers, he travels to a mysterious sanctuary and discovers a hidden world of magic. Under a demanding mentor, he must overcome his arrogance and learn to use unfamiliar powers against forces threatening reality.

movies.title: Ice Age
movies.plot: During a harsh prehistoric winter, a lonely mammoth, a talkative sloth, and a saber-toothed tiger form an unlikely group to return a human baby to its family. Their dangerous journey across the frozen wilderness brings comic mishaps, tense encounters, and an unexpected bond between three very different companions.

movies.title: Howl's Moving Castle
movies.plot: After a witch curses a young milliner and transforms her into an elderly woman, she leaves home and finds shelter in a wizard’s moving castle. There, she becomes entangled in a magical world of spells, unusual companions, and a conflict involving the kingdom.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
movies.plot: After a frightening encounter outside school, a young wizard faces punishment while authorities deny that a powerful evil has returned. Back at Hogwarts, a strict new teacher imposes control, prompting him and his classmates to secretly practice defensive magic and prepare for the dangers ahead.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
movies.plot: As danger spreads through both magical and non-magical communities, a young wizard returns to school while a powerful mentor prepares him for the conflict ahead.
