Guided by mysterious memories and an unusual old textbook, he investigates a dark past as classmates face romance, uncertainty, and growing threats.

movies.title: Cars
movies.plot: A hotshot rookie race car headed for a major championship is unexpectedly stranded in a sleepy Route 66 town. As he repairs the damage he caused and gets to know the local residents, he begins to discover that success is about more than reaching the finish line.

movies.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
movies.plot: During wartime, four siblings are sent to the countryside, where a wardrobe leads them into Narnia, a magical land trapped in endless winter. With help from a noble lion and an array of talking creatures, they become part of a struggle to free the kingdom from an icy ruler.

movies.title: White Chicks
movies.plot: After a botched drug bust puts their careers at risk, two FBI brothers are assigned to protect wealthy socialites from a kidnapping plot. When the sisters refuse to travel after a minor accident, the agents disguise themselves as their clients and enter a world of parties, vanity, and unexpected danger.

movies.title: 12 Angry Men
movies.plot: After a murder trial, twelve jurors enter a room to decide the fate of a young man accused of killing his father. When one juror questions the seemingly certain verdict, the group must reexamine the evidence, confront personal prejudices, and determine whether reasonable doubt remains.

movies.title: All That We Never Were
movies.plot: After a tragic car accident claims her parents, a 19-year-old woman moves to a coastal town to live under the care of her brother’s best friend. As she faces grief, unsettling nightmares, and a fractured sense of self, she begins a difficult coming-of-age journey.

movies.title: John Wick: Chapter 4
movies.plot: With a bounty on his head, a legendary assassin searches for a way to escape a powerful criminal organization. His journey takes him across the globe, where he confronts a dangerous new adversary, relies on old connections, and battles overwhelming forces in pursuit of freedom.

movies.title: Apex
movies.plot: Grieving and determined to test herself, a woman ventures alone into the Australian wilderness, where a hostile landscape becomes even more dangerous when she is drawn into a deadly pursuit with a calculating killer who sees her as prey.

movies.title: Ready or Not 2: Here I Come
movies.plot: After surviving a deadly family game, a hardened woman is pulled into an even larger night of violence with her estranged sister. Together, they must evade hunters from four powerful rival families while facing a brutal contest whose prize is control of a secretive global council.

movies.title: Hokum
movies.plot: A novelist retreats to a remote Irish inn to scatter his parents’ ashes beneath a meaningful tree. After hearing stories about a witch confined to the honeymoon suite, he experiences disturbing visions and becomes entangled in a disappearance that forces him to face painful parts of his past.

movies.title: Wuthering Heights
movies.plot: In 18th-century England, tragedy unfolds when a passionate young man falls in love with a woman from a wealthy family. Their forbidden relationship is tested by social expectations, ambition, and the demands of a world determined to keep them apart.

movies.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
movies.plot: After the death of Wakanda’s king, the nation’s leaders and defenders struggle to protect their home from foreign pressure and a powerful underwater civilization. As grief, responsibility, and competing claims threaten to divide them, a young inventor and her allies must help shape Wakanda’s uncertain future.

movies.title: Scream 7
movies.plot: When a new Ghostface killer targets a quiet town, a battle-hardened mother must protect her teenage daughter from a deadly threat tied to her own troubled past. As the attacks escalate, the family is forced to confront familiar horrors while trying to uncover who can be trusted.

movies.title: Red One
movies.plot: When a legendary holiday figure is kidnapped, a North Pole security chief must join forces with a notorious tracker. Their globe-trotting rescue mission mixes festive magic, mythical creatures, explosive action, and reluctant teamwork as they race to save Christmas.

movies.title: The Brutalist
movies.plot: After fleeing post-war Europe, an ambitious architect arrives in Pennsylvania hoping to rebuild his career and reunite with his wife. A wealthy patron offers him a major project, but the opportunity brings difficult power dynamics, personal strain, and a challenging path toward belonging in modern America.

movies.title: The Martian
movies.plot: After a storm forces a Mars mission to evacuate, an astronaut is presumed dead and left behind. Alone with limited supplies, he must use his ingenuity, humor, and scientific knowledge to survive on the hostile planet while people on Earth work to find a way to bring him home.

movies.title: Man of Steel
movies.plot: A young man with extraordinary powers searches for answers about his origins and purpose. As a threat from his distant homeworld endangers Earth, he must embrace his abilities and decide what kind of hero he will become.

movies.title: Gone Girl
movies.plot: When a wife disappears on her wedding anniversary, her husband becomes the center of a relentless media storm and a police investigation. As public suspicion grows, the image of their seemingly ordinary marriage begins to fracture, raising unsettling questions about trust, appearances, and what may have happened.

movies.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
movies.plot: In a bleak future, mutant-hunting robots threaten both mutants and humans. A mutant warrior is sent back to the 1970s, where he must unite younger versions of key allies and prevent a pivotal event before history leads to catastrophe.

movies.title: Guardians of the Galaxy: Vol. 2
movies.plot: A spacefaring team struggles to stay united while confronting threats, old wounds, and questions surrounding one member’s mysterious parentage. Along the way, each member faces personal challenges that test their trust, loyalty, and idea of family.

movies.title: Frozen
movies.plot: A young princess sets out to end an eternal winter that has overtaken her kingdom. Joined by an ice seller, a reindeer, and a cheerful snowman, she faces a dangerous journey while discovering the meaning of family, friendship, courage, and true love.

movies.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
movies.plot: Years after a plague devastates humanity, survivors in the ruins of San Francisco encounter a nearby community of intelligent apes. A fragile understanding forms when the humans need access to a power source in ape territory, but fear, old grievances, and opposing leaders threaten to turn cooperation into open conflict.

movies.title: Ratatouille
movies.plot: A gifted rat dreams of becoming a chef and finds an unlikely partner in a young kitchen worker at a Paris restaurant. Together, they pursue culinary ambitions while facing suspicion from the kitchen staff, pressure from the rat’s colony, and the judgment of an influential food critic.

movies.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest
movies.plot: A clever pirate faces a supernatural debt that could condemn him to eternal servitude. As he searches for a way out, a young couple are pulled into the dangerous quest while trying to avoid punishment for helping him, bringing them into conflict with sea monsters and rival forces.

movies.title: Insidious: Chapter 2
movies.plot: After a disturbing encounter leaves the Lambert family facing continued supernatural danger, they search for answers about a childhood connection to the spirit world. As unsettling events spread between the past and present, the family and their allies work to understand the forces threatening them.

movies.title: Cars 2
movies.plot: A champion race car travels overseas with his best friend for the World Grand Prix. When the friend becomes entangled in an international espionage adventure, their trip turns into a fast-paced mix of racing, gadgets, danger, and unexpected teamwork.

movies.title: The Truman Show
movies.plot: In a picture-perfect seaside town, an insurance salesman starts noticing that his routine life feels strangely artificial. As unusual events challenge everything he believes about his world, he begins questioning who is watching, what is real, and whether he can choose his own path.

movies.title: Enemy at the Gates
movies.plot: During the Battle of Stalingrad, a talented Russian marksman becomes a symbol of hope for his side. As propaganda raises his profile, a highly skilled German sniper arrives to hunt him, turning the wider conflict into a tense personal struggle amid a devastated city.

movies.title: The Godfather Part II
movies.plot: A young immigrant builds a new life in New York after fleeing Sicily, gradually establishing influence in the city’s criminal underworld. Decades later, his son expands the family business across Las Vegas, Hollywood, and Cuba while struggling to maintain control and protect his family.

movies.title: Jana Nayagan
movies.plot: A former police officer is drawn back into conflict when a child’s silent fear reawakines an old clash between someone who stands with the people and someone driven by control. What begins as a personal reckoning grows into a much larger battle.

movies.title: Killers of the Flower Moon
movies.plot: In 1920s Oklahoma, oil wealth transforms an Indigenous community’s fortunes, but a series of killings exposes a ruthless campaign driven by greed and power. As fear spreads, federal investigators arrive to uncover the truth behind the crimes and the forces protecting those responsible.

movies.title: Iron Man 3
movies.plot: After a traumatic battle leaves him struggling with anxiety, a brilliant inventor faces a terrorist threat that destroys his home and disrupts his life. Forced to rely less on advanced armor, he follows a dangerous trail while rebuilding his confidence, protecting those closest to him, and confronting the consequences of his past.

movies.title: Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair
movies.plot: After waking from a four-year coma caused by an attack on her wedding day, a former assassin sets out on a relentless quest for revenge. Armed with a carefully prepared hit list, she faces dangerous enemies while confronting the physical and emotional costs of her violent past.

movies.title: Moana 2
movies.plot: After an unexpected message from her ancestors, a young wayfinder sets out across Oceania with a legendary demigod and a new crew. Together, they face dangerous waters, ancient mysteries, and a mission that could reconnect scattered communities while testing their teamwork and courage.

movies.title: Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom
movies.plot: A powerful enemy returns seeking revenge and threatens Atlantis with an ancient weapon. To defend the underwater kingdom, Arthur must form an uneasy alliance with his imprisoned brother, forcing former rivals to work together against a growing danger.

movies.title: Incredibles 2
movies.plot: With superheroes still struggling to regain public acceptance, a family faces a fresh challenge when one parent takes the lead in crime-fighting and the other stays home. Balancing dangerous missions with schoolwork, family tensions, and a baby’s unpredictable powers, they discover that teamwork is essential both in costume and at home.

movies.title: Ted 2
movies.plot: A newlywed talking teddy bear and his wife hope to have a child, but a legal dispute threatens their plans when the bear is classified as property rather than a person. With help from a young lawyer and his best friend, he heads to court to fight for recognition.

movies.title: The Incredibles
movies.plot: A retired superhero struggles to balance a dull office job with raising a family in suburbia. When a mysterious assignment offers a chance to return to action, he and his superpowered family face dangerous challenges that test their teamwork, courage, and commitment to living an ordinary life.

movies.title: Shutter Island
movies.plot: A World War II veteran turned U.S. Marshal investigates a patient’s disappearance from a remote hospital for the criminally insane. As troubling visions and evasive staff complicate the case, the isolated island becomes an increasingly unsettling maze of suspicion and uncertainty.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
movies.plot: A young wizard is unexpectedly chosen to compete in a dangerous contest between three magical schools, despite being underage. As he faces a series of demanding challenges with help from his friends, troubling signs point toward the return of a powerful dark force.

movies.title: Toy Story 2
movies.plot: When a beloved cowboy toy is taken by a collector, his friends launch a daring rescue mission. Meanwhile, he meets new toys who challenge his ideas about friendship, purpose, and what it means to be loved as children grow up.

movies.title: Die Hard
movies.plot: During a Christmas party in a Los Angeles skyscraper, terrorists seize the building and take hostages. An off-duty police officer escapes capture and must navigate the tower alone, using his resourcefulness to survive, protect those inside, and find a way to stop the attackers.

movies.title: Once Upon a Time in America
movies.plot: Decades after leaving New York’s Lower East Side, a former gangster returns to confront memories and regrets from his criminal youth. Spanning generations, the story explores friendship, ambition, loyalty, romance, violence, and the lasting consequences of choices made during a changing America.

movies.title: Back to the 90s
movies.plot: Five lifelong friends finally get a chance to pursue their dream of becoming a successful boy band. When one member begins to question the plan, the group must pull together as an unexpected journey sends them into a different decade.

movies.title: The Brink of War
movies.plot: A U.S. president races against time to salvage a high-stakes agreement with a Soviet leader that could reduce nuclear arsenals or trigger catastrophe. As pressure builds from every direction, each conversation pushes the world toward either peace or destruction.

movies.title: Revenge
movies.plot: After his wife is brutally murdered, a decorated special forces veteran becomes consumed by revenge. When an unexpected turn of fortune makes him wealthy, he uses his money to build an arsenal and joins his closest soldiers in pursuing those responsible.

movies.title: Elemental
movies.plot: In a city where fire, water, land, and air residents live together, a fiery young woman and a carefree water inspector form an unlikely connection. As they work to protect her family’s business, they face differences in temperament, background, and expectations while discovering how much they share.

movies.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
movies.plot: An aging immigrant running a struggling family business is pulled into a chaotic multiverse adventure. As alternate lives and bizarre dangers collide, she must confront her relationships, regrets, and the possibility that saving what matters most begins with understanding her family.

movies.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
movies.plot: A retired thunder god is drawn back into action when a cosmic killer targets the gods. Joined by a powerful former partner, a warrior king, and a rock-like ally, he races across the universe to rescue captured children, confront the threat, and rediscover his purpose.

movies.title: Toy Story 4
movies.plot: A loyal toy faces a new challenge when a child creates an anxious plaything from everyday materials. During a road trip, old friends and unexpected companions encounter playful dangers and difficult choices that make the toy reconsider loyalty, purpose, and what it means to belong.

movies.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
movies.plot: A pair of paranormal investigators take on one final terrifying case involving a haunted family home and mysterious entities. As the investigation grows more personal, they must confront frightening forces while their family faces its own supernatural danger.

movies.title: The Maze Runner
movies.plot: A teenager with no memory awakens in a walled enclosure where a group of boys has built a fragile society beside a vast, shifting maze. As he learns their rules, dangerous expeditions and new clues push him to challenge the group’s routines and search for a way out.

movies.title: Green Book
movies.plot: In 1962, a working-class bouncer is hired to drive a celebrated pianist on a concert tour through the segregated American South. As they face hostility, unequal treatment, and unfamiliar surroundings, their uneasy partnership gradually develops into mutual understanding and companionship.

movies.title: Get Out
movies.plot: A young photographer travels with his girlfriend to meet her parents at their secluded country home. What begins as an awkward but seemingly welcoming visit grows increasingly unsettling as strange behavior and disturbing discoveries make him question the family’s intentions and his own safety.

movies.title: The Prestige
movies.plot: Two stage magicians become locked in a bitter rivalry after a tragic accident, each pursuing the perfect illusion while obsession, deceit, and jealousy push them toward increasingly dangerous choices. Set in Victorian-era London, their competition demands sacrifice and keeps the truth just out of reach.

movies.title: The Intouchables
movies.plot: Based on a true story, a wealthy quadriplegic aristocrat hires a young man from the projects as his caregiver. Though they come from very different worlds, their unexpected partnership develops into a lively friendship filled with humor, warmth, and mutual understanding.

movies.title: Batman Begins
movies.plot: Driven by childhood tragedy, a wealthy man returns home determined to confront the corruption consuming his city. Unable to trust the system, he draws on hard-won training, advanced resources, and a carefully crafted identity to become a frightening symbol for criminals.

movies.title: Kraven the Hunter
movies.plot: A young man’s difficult relationship with his ruthless gangster father sends him on a path of vengeance. After a transformative encounter in the wilderness, he develops extraordinary abilities and dedicates himself to becoming the world’s greatest hunter while facing dangerous criminals and brutal consequences.

movies.title: Tangled
movies.plot: A spirited teenager with long, magical hair longs to leave the tower where she has been confined and see floating lanterns on her eighteenth birthday. After making a deal with a charming wanted thief, she embarks on an adventurous journey beyond the world she has always known.

movies.title: Mean Girls
movies.plot: A sheltered teenager enters an American high school and is drawn into its popular clique. As she navigates friendship, romance, rivalry, and social pressure, she discovers how easily fitting in can change the way she treats others.

movies.title: Saving Private Ryan
movies.plot: During the Normandy invasion, a captain and his small team are ordered to cross enemy-held territory and find a missing paratrooper. With the mission placing them in constant danger, the soldiers must confront fear, loyalty, sacrifice, and the devastating human cost of war.

movies.title: Good Will Hunting
movies.plot: A headstrong young genius from a working-class background works as a janitor while hiding extraordinary mathematical talent. After trouble with the law threatens his future, he is required to work with a professor and attend therapy, where a guarded relationship gradually challenges his defenses.

movies.title: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York
movies.plot: A young boy accidentally travels to New York without his family and settles into a luxurious hotel using a parent’s credit card. While exploring the city, he encounters two familiar burglars planning a holiday robbery and uses his cleverness, courage, and elaborate traps to stop them.

movies.title: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan: Ghost War
movies.plot: A reluctant intelligence operative is drawn back into espionage when an international covert mission exposes a deadly conspiracy. Racing against time, he joins trusted CIA allies and a sharp MI6 officer to confront a rogue black-operations unit in a high-stakes personal conflict.

movies.title: Ne Zha 2
movies.plot: After a catastrophic event destroys their bodies, two unlikely friends receive a fragile second chance at life. As dragon clans and celestial forces move toward conflict, they face perilous trials that test their bond, challenge their identities, and place the fate of mortals and immortals at risk.

movies.title: Real Steel
movies.plot: In the near future, robot boxing has become a popular sport. A struggling former fighter reluctantly teams up with his estranged young son after discovering a discarded robot, hoping to rebuild it into an unlikely contender while repairing their fractured relationship.

movies.title: Black Box
movies.plot: A routine domestic flight descends into terror when inexplicable phenomena, bizarre technological failures, supernatural events, and alien influences disrupt the journey. As reality begins to blur with nightmare, the passengers must work together and fight for survival against increasingly strange and dangerous forces.

movies.title: Protector
movies.plot: After her daughter is kidnapped, a former military operative is pulled into a dangerous criminal underworld. Hunted by law enforcement and military forces, she pushes through escalating threats and violent confrontations in a determined effort to bring her child home.

movies.title: Who's That Girl
movies.plot: An uptight New York tax lawyer is assigned to escort a spirited ex-convict to the bus station. Instead, she pulls him into a frantic citywide quest to prove her innocence, sending his orderly life into a series of comic misadventures.

movies.title: Shake, Rattle & Roll: Evil Origins
movies.plot: Three horror stories unfold across the Philippines in 1775, 2025, and 2050. Nuns struggle through a terrifying night after an unknown evil is unleashed, friends face a deadly attack at a masquerade ball, and survivors confront a post-apocalyptic world ruled by aswang.

movies.title: Zero Woman
movies.plot: When a valuable suitcase is stolen, the mob, petty criminals, and a beautiful agent from the Elite Zero division are pulled into a battle to settle the score.

movies.title: Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood
movies.plot: Los Angeles, 1969: a fading television western star and his longtime stuntman friend try to find their place in a changing Hollywood. As the actor works to revive his career, life unfolds around a glamorous young neighbor and the uneasy atmosphere surrounding the city’s shifting culture.

movies.title: Black Widow
movies.plot: A former spy on the run confronts a dangerous conspiracy connected to her childhood and the organization that shaped her. Forced to reunite with a sister-like figure and a fractured former family, she must face painful memories while trying to free others from the same control.

movies.title: Black Adam
movies.plot: After nearly 5,000 years imprisoned in an ancient tomb, a powerful figure is freed and returns to a modern world under oppression. As he delivers his ruthless version of justice, a group of heroes arrives to challenge his methods and determine whether he is a savior or a threat.

movies.title: Meg 2: The Trench
movies.plot: A daring research team ventures into the deepest ocean trench, where their mission is disrupted by a dangerous mining operation. Facing betrayal, giant prehistoric sharks, and other creatures from the depths, the survivors must fight their way through a chaotic struggle for survival.

movies.title: 28 Years Later
movies.plot: Twenty-eight years after a devastating virus outbreak, a fortified island community remains isolated from the mainland. When a young boy ventures beyond its defenses with his father, he encounters a transformed landscape, frightening infected creatures, and survivors whose lives have been reshaped by years of quarantine and fear.

movies.title: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
movies.plot: A quiet hobbit is drawn into an epic quest by a wizard and thirteen dwarves seeking to reclaim their mountain home from a dragon. Leaving behind a comfortable life, the reluctant traveler faces dangerous creatures, unfamiliar lands, and challenges that test his courage along the way.

movies.title: Deadpool
movies.plot: After a mercenary undergoes a rogue experiment that leaves him with accelerated healing and a disfigured appearance, he adopts a wisecracking masked identity. Driven by love and revenge, he sets out to confront the man responsible, using brutal skills and an irreverent sense of humor.

movies.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
movies.plot: An ancient mutant awakens with a plan to reshape the world and places powerful mutants under his command. A group of younger heroes must overcome their fears, join forces, and confront this overwhelming threat before humanity faces destruction.

movies.title: World War Z
movies.plot: When a mysterious infection turns people into rampaging zombies, a former international investigator and his family struggle to escape the spreading chaos. He is then sent around the world to investigate the disease, facing relentless danger and desperate odds while searching for answers that could help humanity survive.

movies.title: Dunkirk
movies.plot: During World War II, hundreds of thousands of Allied troops are trapped on the beaches of Dunkirk as enemy forces close in. Their survival unfolds through the experiences of stranded soldiers, civilian sailors crossing the channel, and pilots fighting overhead during a desperate evacuation.

movies.title: A Quiet Place
movies.plot: A family struggles to survive in a world overrun by creatures that hunt through sound. Forced to communicate quietly and move with extreme care, they must protect one another while facing the constant danger of making even the smallest noise.

movies.title: Your Name.
movies.plot: Two high school students living in different parts of Japan unexpectedly begin switching bodies. As the strange exchanges continue, they adapt to one another’s routines and leave messages to stay connected, gradually forming an unusual bond while trying to understand what is happening.

movies.title: Train to Busan
movies.plot: When a zombie virus throws Korea into an emergency, passengers on an express train to Busan become trapped in a rapidly escalating fight for survival. As the outbreak spreads through the train, strangers must navigate fear, danger, and difficult choices while searching for a way forward.

movies.title: Thor
movies.plot: An arrogant warrior god is cast down to Earth after recklessly reigniting an ancient war against his father’s wishes. Living among humans, he must learn humility and what true heroism means when dangerous forces from his home realm threaten the planet.

movies.title: Inglourious Basterds
movies.plot: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a squad of Jewish-American soldiers wages a brutal campaign against Nazi forces. Their path intersects with a young French-Jewish woman who runs a Paris cinema and becomes involved in a dangerous plan targeting prominent Nazi figures.

movies.title: Corpse Bride
movies.plot: In a gloomy Victorian village, a nervous young man preparing for an arranged marriage accidentally vows himself to a mysterious corpse bride. Taken to the colorful world of the dead, he searches for a way back to his living fiancée while confronting questions of love, duty, and acceptance.

movies.title: Cars 3
movies.plot: A legendary racer struggles to keep up when a faster generation takes over the sport. With help from an ambitious young technician, guidance inspired by a former mentor, and a renewed approach to training, he fights for another chance on the track.

movies.title: The Mummy
movies.plot: In 1920s Egypt, a daring adventurer and an Egyptologist journey to a legendary lost city in search of treasure. Their expedition awakens an ancient, powerful evil, forcing them to face supernatural dangers, deadly curses, and a threat that could bring ruin to the world.

movies.title: The Shining
movies.plot: A struggling writer takes a winter caretaker job at a remote hotel, moving there with his wife and young son. Cut off from the outside world, the family faces an increasingly oppressive environment and unsettling forces that threaten their safety and sanity.

movies.title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
movies.plot: As the Civil War rages, a quiet loner, a ruthless hired killer, and a Mexican bandit pursue a strongbox filled with stolen gold. Their search across a war-torn frontier forces these morally questionable rivals into uneasy cooperation, while each tries to outwit the others and claim the fortune.

movies.title: Scarface
movies.plot: A Cuban immigrant builds a powerful drug empire in Miami, rising through violence, ambition, and ruthless deals. As police pressure, cartel conflicts, and paranoia intensify, his wealth and influence begin threatening the relationships and stability he struggled to gain.

movies.title: One Night Only
movies.plot: In a society where unmarried people are forbidden from having sex except during one annual twelve-hour window, two lonely strangers set out with very different hopes for the night. As they repeatedly cross paths during a series of misadventures, they begin questioning what they really want from this unusual opportunity.

movies.title: Lesbian Space Princess
movies.plot: A sheltered space princess is pushed into an intergalactic rescue mission after her bounty hunter ex-girlfriend is kidnapped by a group of straight aliens. Facing dangerous enemies and her own insecurity, she must find the courage to leave behind expectations and discover her inner strength.

movies.title: Blades of the Guardians
movies.plot: A wanted fugitive accepts a dangerous escort mission, protecting another highly sought-after fugitive on a journey to Chang’an. Pursued by bounty hunters and imperial forces, the pair must cross harsh desert terrain while relying on uneasy allies and facing relentless martial arts battles.

movies.title: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East
movies.plot: A chef travels to the Middle East to work in a Chinese restaurant and help pay off family debts. As the restaurant gains fame for its authentic food, war erupts around them, placing the staff, their customers, and their hopes for a peaceful future under immense pressure.

movies.title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
movies.plot: A team of brave rescue pups lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet a stranded pup. When reckless mining activity awakens a volcano, the team must mount its biggest rescue mission yet to protect the island and its inhabitants.

movies.title: The Bay
movies.plot: Two best friends travel to Thailand for a destination wedding, but their trip takes a terrifying turn when they become trapped aboard a sinking tour boat in a tiger shark sanctuary. As the danger closes in, they must struggle to survive in unforgiving waters.

movies.title: Send Help
movies.plot: After a plane crash, two colleagues are stranded on a deserted island with little hope of rescue. Forced to rely on each other, they face the island’s dangers while old workplace resentments fuel an increasingly tense battle of wills, survival skills, and shifting power.

movies.title: Scream VI
movies.plot: After a new wave of Ghostface killings, four survivors leave Woodsboro for New York City, hoping to start over. Their attempt at a fresh chapter is disrupted when a relentless masked attacker targets them, forcing the group to confront danger, suspicion, and the lasting trauma of what happened before.

movies.title: Knives Out
movies.plot: After a renowned crime novelist is found dead at his estate following a birthday gathering, an inquisitive detective begins questioning the family and household staff. As conflicting accounts, hidden motives, and self-serving lies emerge, the investigation becomes an entertaining puzzle filled with red herrings and unexpected turns.

movies.title: Soul
movies.plot: A middle school teacher and passionate jazz musician has an accident that separates his soul from his body. In a strange realm where souls develop before entering the world, he enlists the help of a reluctant soul-in-training while searching for a way back to Earth.

movies.title: Snow White
movies.plot: After a benevolent king disappears, a cruel queen takes control of the kingdom and targets a young princess. Fleeing into the forest, the princess finds seven magical dwarves and a daring bandit, joining them in a fight to survive the queen’s pursuit and reclaim their home.

movies.title: Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die
movies.plot: A mysterious visitor claiming to come from the future arrives at a Los Angeles diner and recruits a carefully chosen group of unhappy patrons. Together, they embark on a dangerous overnight mission to prevent a rogue artificial intelligence from threatening the world, while police close in and the recruits’ troubled pasts emerge.

movies.title: Wrath of Man
movies.plot: A cold, mysterious security guard joins a Los Angeles cash-truck company and shocks his colleagues by displaying extraordinary precision during a heist. As the crew tries to understand his past, the job becomes tied to a personal mission involving revenge and dangerous criminal networks.

movies.title: Final Destination: Bloodlines
movies.plot: Haunted by a recurring nightmare about a past disaster, a college student returns home seeking answers from an older family member who may know how to break the cycle. As strange accidents begin threatening her relatives, she races to uncover the connection before fate catches up with them.

movies.title: Road House
movies.plot: A former mixed martial arts fighter accepts a job as a bouncer at a roadhouse in a tropical island community. What initially seems like a chance to start over soon draws him into escalating trouble involving criminals, local power struggles, and a steady stream of dangerous challengers.

movies.title: The Revenant
movies.plot: In the 1820s, a frontiersman is left for dead after a brutal bear attack in the wilderness. Fighting through severe injuries, harsh weather, and danger from rival groups, he begins a relentless journey driven by survival and revenge.

movies.title: Black Panther
movies.plot: A newly crowned ruler returns to a hidden, technologically advanced African nation and faces challenges to the throne from within and beyond its borders. Taking on a legendary warrior mantle, the leader joins allies, family, and an American agent to protect the country from being pulled into global conflict.

movies.title: Arrival
movies.plot: After alien crafts appear around the world, a skilled linguist joins a military-led effort to communicate with their mysterious occupants. As international tensions rise, she must work carefully to understand their language and intentions before fear turns the encounter into a global crisis.

movies.title: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
movies.plot: After a dragon attacks a lakeside town, a hobbit and a company of dwarves defend a mountain of treasure claimed by rival men and elves. As a vast orc army approaches, old disputes must give way to an uneasy alliance in a battle that could determine the fate of the wider world.

movies.title: Hereditary
movies.plot: After the death of a family matriarch, a grieving household uncovers disturbing secrets about its heritage. As tensions rise and unsettling events intensify, a mother and her children struggle to understand what is happening while their family begins to unravel.

movies.title: Beauty and the Beast
movies.plot: A beautiful young woman is drawn into a magical castle after a cursed prince takes her father captive. As she spends time among the enchanted residents, she begins to see beyond the prince’s frightening appearance and confronts the forces threatening the spell’s future.

movies.title: V for Vendetta
movies.plot: In a future where a fascist government controls Britain through fear and surveillance, a masked vigilante launches a campaign against those in power. After rescuing a young woman from the secret police, he gains an unexpected ally in his fight to awaken a frightened population and reclaim its freedom.

movies.title: Zodiac
movies.plot: Over a decade, a San Francisco newspaper team and law enforcement officials investigate a series of murders linked by cryptic messages and uncertain evidence. As public attention fades, a determined cartoonist becomes increasingly consumed by the case, pursuing clues that others have abandoned.

movies.title: Kung Fu Panda
movies.plot: A clumsy panda who dreams of mastering kung fu is unexpectedly chosen for a legendary role, despite doubts from everyone around him. With guidance from a reluctant teacher and a group of skilled warriors, he must face a dangerous threat and discover that his greatest strength comes from accepting himself.

movies.title: Despicable Me 4
movies.plot: A former supervillain turned family man faces danger when an old nemesis escapes and seeks revenge. Forced into witness protection, he and his family adopt new identities while trying to fit into suburban life, as a mischievous neighbor draws him into an unexpected scheme.

movies.title: Grown Ups
movies.plot: After their beloved high school basketball coach dies, five longtime friends reunite with their families for a Fourth of July holiday weekend. As they spend time together, old friendships, family dynamics, and different paths in adulthood shape a relaxed gathering filled with jokes and casual misadventures.

movies.title: Léon: The Professional
movies.plot: A highly skilled hitman becomes the reluctant protector of a twelve-year-old girl after violence destroys her family. As she seeks revenge against those responsible, their uneasy partnership develops into an unexpected bond, forcing him to confront a life built around isolation and violence.

movies.title: Mission: Impossible
movies.plot: After a disastrous espionage mission leaves him under suspicion, a skilled agent must uncover the mole within the CIA and clear his name. Working with a small group of disavowed operatives, he pursues a sensitive list through tense assignments, elaborate deceptions, and dangerous international confrontations.

movies.title: Aladdin
movies.plot: In the bustling city of Agrabah, a kind-hearted street urchin and a princess fall in love despite expectations that she marry royalty. When a power-hungry court official seeks a magical lamp capable of granting wishes, the young man becomes caught in a thrilling adventure of disguise, romance, and self-discovery.

movies.title: Taxi Driver
movies.plot: Suffering from insomnia, a disturbed loner takes a job driving a New York City taxi through the night. As he witnesses the city’s crime and decay, his isolation deepens and he begins searching for a drastic way to impose his own idea of order.

movies.title: GoodFellas
movies.plot: A young Brooklyn man is drawn into the glamorous but dangerous world of organized crime, joining a neighborhood crew and rising within its ranks. As loyalty, ambition, and violence shape his life, the rewards of this lifestyle begin to reveal a darker cost.

movies.title: Dead Poets Society
movies.plot: At a prestigious New England boarding school, an unconventional English teacher encourages his students to question tradition, discover their passions, and make their own choices. Their growing confidence brings them into conflict with the school’s rigid authorities and the expectations placed on them by their families.

movies.title: Apocalypse Now
movies.plot: During the Vietnam War, a weary army officer receives a secret mission to travel deep into enemy territory and find a rogue commander leading his own forces. As the dangerous river journey unfolds, he encounters escalating violence, confusion, and the psychological devastation of war.

movies.title: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
movies.plot: A beautiful young woman flees into the forest to escape her jealous stepmother, who fears losing her reputation as the fairest in the land. She finds shelter with seven cheerful dwarfs, but the danger follows her into their secluded home.

movies.title: DC
movies.plot: A rebel joins forces with a determined ally in a dangerous world where passion and peril collide. Their turbulent alliance faces bloodshed, shifting loyalties, and the constant pressure of survival as they struggle to endure a brutal fight.

movies.title: The Isolate Thief
movies.plot: A young woman tries to hide stolen gold after violent outlaws take control of her remote outpost. Trapped in an isolated setting, she must stay alert while protecting her secret and finding a way to survive.

movies.title: The Flash
movies.plot: After trying to save his family, a speedster accidentally changes the future and becomes trapped in a reality threatened by an old alien enemy. With familiar heroes missing and a retired vigilante as his unlikely ally, he must find a way to protect this world and return to the one he remembers.

movies.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
movies.plot: A young man living an ordinary life is pulled back toward a powerful organization connected to his family’s past. As he confronts buried history, he must navigate complicated loyalties, remarkable martial arts, and a mystical world that challenges his understanding of who he is.

movies.title: Tenet
movies.plot: An elite operative is drawn into a covert international mission involving a mysterious word and a threat to humanity’s survival. As the investigation unfolds, he navigates espionage, shifting timelines, and events that challenge ordinary ideas about cause and effect.

movies.title: Free Guy
movies.plot: A cheerful bank teller discovers that his everyday life unfolds inside an open-world video game. With help from someone connected to the real world, he begins breaking from his routine, embracing unexpected possibilities, and trying to protect the digital world he calls home.

movies.title: Tuner
movies.plot: A former piano prodigy whose hearing condition ends his performance ambitions becomes a piano tuner. His exceptional sensitivity to sound soon reveals an unexpected talent for opening safes, drawing him into risky criminal schemes while he tries to protect his livelihood, relationships, and future.

movies.title: John Wick: Chapter 3 - Parabellum
movies.plot: A legendary assassin is marked excommunicado after breaking a strict rule of the international guild that once governed his life. With a massive bounty placed on him, he races through a dangerous underworld while former allies, rival killers, and powerful authorities close in.

movies.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
movies.plot: An investigative reporter and his alien symbiote partner struggle to live together while confronting a dangerous new symbiote born from a convicted serial killer. Their uneasy partnership is tested as the threat grows, blending chaotic action, dark humor, and a fast-moving superhero adventure.

movies.title: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish
movies.plot: A legendary adventurer learns that reckless exploits have left him with only one life. He sets out on a dangerous journey to find a mythical wish and restore what he has lost, while confronting fear, forming unexpected friendships, and discovering what truly matters.

movies.title: The Conjuring: The Devil Made Me Do It
movies.plot: Paranormal investigators confront a disturbing case involving a young boy, demonic possession, and a violent crime. Their search for answers takes them beyond a single haunted home and into a wider investigation involving occult forces, dangerous encounters, and an unusual legal defense.

movies.title: The Fall Guy
movies.plot: After a near career-ending accident, a stuntman is drawn back to a film set when its leading actor disappears. While searching for him and uncovering a dangerous conspiracy, he also tries to repair a broken romance and keep up with the hazardous demands of his job.

movies.title: Maleficent: Mistress of Evil
movies.plot: A powerful guardian and her goddaughter face growing tension as a royal wedding approaches. Their differing views draw them into a wider conflict involving complicated family ties, unexpected allies, and dangerous new forces threatening their magical world.

movies.title: Thor: The Dark World
movies.plot: A powerful warrior must defend the cosmos when an ancient enemy seeks to plunge the universe into darkness. As the threat reaches both a fantastical realm and Earth, he faces a dangerous mission involving old allies, family tensions, and difficult sacrifices.

movies.title: John Wick: Chapter 2
movies.plot: A legendary assassin is pulled out of retirement by a former associate seeking control of a secret international guild. Bound by a blood oath, he travels to Rome and faces a relentless network of highly trained killers while confronting the consequences of returning to his old life.

movies.title: The Pianist
movies.plot: A gifted pianist struggles to survive in Warsaw as Nazi occupation forces Jewish residents into a ghetto and tears families apart. After losing his home and work, he relies on chance, quiet acts of help, and his determination while hiding amid a city devastated by war.

movies.title: Sonic the Hedgehog 3
movies.plot: A speedy blue hero reunites with two close allies when a mysterious, exceptionally powerful adversary threatens the planet. Outmatched by this new foe, the trio must set aside their differences and seek an unlikely alliance before the danger grows beyond their control.

movies.title: Pride & Prejudice
movies.plot: A gentleman’s family faces an uncertain future because their home will pass to a distant male relative, making advantageous marriages seem essential. Amid balls, social expectations, misunderstandings, and clashing first impressions, an independent young woman navigates family pressures while reconsidering her views of a wealthy, reserved gentleman.

movies.title: xXx: Return of Xander Cage
movies.plot: After being presumed dead, an extreme-sports expert secretly returns to action for a dangerous assignment. Working with a diverse team, he must recover a powerful device while facing skilled opponents and navigating a high-risk international mission.

movies.title: Eyes Wide Shut
movies.plot: After a married doctor is unsettled by his wife's confession about a past fantasy, he wanders through New York seeking answers and temptation. His search leads him toward an exclusive masked gathering, drawing him into an unsettling world of desire, secrecy, and personal risk.

movies.title: Black Hawk Down
movies.plot: During a mission to capture two senior aides of a Somali warlord, U.S. Rangers and elite soldiers find themselves trapped in a hostile city after helicopters are shot down. Heavily outnumbered, they fight through chaotic streets while trying to rescue stranded comrades and return to safety.

movies.title: Blade Runner
movies.plot: In a smog-filled dystopian Los Angeles, a retired detective is called back to hunt four escaped replicants—genetically engineered beings who have come to Earth seeking their creator and a chance to extend their brief lives. The assignment draws him into a bleak mystery about identity, mortality, and what it means to be human.

movies.title: Malena
movies.plot: In a small Sicilian town during World War II, a 12-year-old boy becomes fascinated by a beautiful, lonely woman whose absent husband leaves her vulnerable to gossip and judgment. Through his innocent perspective, the story explores first love, growing up, beauty, and the cruelty of a watchful community.

movies.title: After We Fell
movies.plot: A young couple’s unstable relationship is tested when her life begins to unravel and long-held family secrets come to light. As they struggle with trust, anger, and difficult choices, their romance faces another period of emotional turmoil and uncertainty.

movies.title: Societies by Accident
movies.plot: Two women discover they were deceived by the same man and are both expecting his child. Joining forces, they set out to confront him and pursue revenge, turning a shared betrayal into an unexpected alliance.

movies.title: Female War: A Nasty Deal
movies.plot: After an accident leaves a painter blind, his spouse becomes desperate to find a cornea donor. When she meets a terminally ill patient willing to help, the two enter a risky agreement that pulls them into a tense and dangerous situation.

movies.title: Frankenstein
movies.plot: A brilliant but arrogant scientist attempts to defeat death by creating new life, unleashing a tragic conflict between creator and creation. This gothic retelling explores loneliness, rejection, trauma, compassion, and the moral consequences of treating scientific ambition as a substitute for humanity.

movies.title: Barbie
movies.plot: A seemingly perfect doll-like world is disrupted when a stereotypical doll begins experiencing unexpected changes. She travels with her companion to the real world, where they encounter unfamiliar social pressures and discoveries that challenge their identities, relationships, and ideas about how life should work.

movies.title: The Rip
movies.plot: When a team of Miami cops discovers millions of dollars hidden in a run-down stash house, trust quickly begins to fracture. As pressure mounts and loyalties are questioned, the officers must navigate a dangerous situation where everyone and everything may not be what it seems.

movies.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
movies.plot: A young survivor is trapped by a violent cult and forced into increasingly dangerous situations. Elsewhere, a compassionate doctor studies an unusually powerful infected person, hoping to understand whether the condition can be changed and what that might mean for humanity’s future.

movies.title: Midsommar
movies.plot: A grieving young woman joins her boyfriend and friends on a trip to a remote Swedish commune for a rare summer festival. As the welcoming community reveals unsettling customs, the visit becomes an increasingly disturbing journey into grief, strained relationships, and cultural disorientation.

movies.title: Captain Marvel
movies.plot: Set in the 1990s, a skilled pilot caught between two alien civilizations begins questioning her memories, loyalties, and extraordinary abilities. As a galactic conflict reaches Earth, she teams up with a young government agent and old friends to uncover the truth and decide where she belongs.

movies.title: Zack Snyder's Justice League
movies.plot: Determined to honor a fallen hero’s sacrifice, a determined vigilante joins forces with a powerful warrior to recruit a team of metahumans. Together, they must unite against an approaching threat capable of catastrophic destruction, while each new member confronts personal struggles and discovers a place within the emerging team.

movies.title: The Gentlemen
movies.plot: An American expatriate running a lucrative marijuana empire in London decides to sell the business and leave the criminal world. The news sets off a scramble among rival operators, opportunists, and schemers, who use bribery, blackmail, and elaborate plots to gain control.

movies.title: Alien: Romulus
movies.plot: While scavenging a derelict space station, a group of young space colonizers encounters a terrifying alien life form. Trapped in the station’s decaying corridors, they must find a way to survive and escape as danger closes in around them.

movies.title: Django Unchained
movies.plot: A newly freed man joins forces with a skilled bounty hunter and learns the trade while searching for his wife, who is held at a brutal Mississippi plantation. Their journey blends rescue, revenge, tense encounters, dark humor, and explosive action across the American South.

movies.title: Star Wars: Episode VIII - The Last Jedi
movies.plot: A young woman works to deepen her newly discovered abilities under the guidance of a reluctant former Jedi. Elsewhere, the dwindling Resistance faces relentless pursuit from the First Order, forcing its leaders and fighters to make difficult choices as they struggle to survive.

movies.title: Nightcrawler
movies.plot: A desperate man breaks into Los Angeles crime journalism, filming disturbing events to sell to television news. As his work gains attention, he increasingly blurs the line between observer and participant, aided by a veteran news editor and a struggling assistant.

movies.title: Aquaman
movies.plot: A half-human, half-underwater-world heir is drawn into an epic journey to discover whether he can claim his birthright and become a true leader. Along the way, he faces rival powers, dangerous challenges, and a conflict threatening both the ocean kingdom and the surface world.

movies.title: Ant-Man
movies.plot: A former thief is recruited by a scientist to wear a remarkable suit that lets him shrink while gaining strength. With help from a determined team, he must master his unusual abilities and carry out a daring heist to protect the technology from a dangerous new threat.

movies.title: A Working Man
movies.plot: A former black-ops operative now works construction and tries to live quietly. When his employer’s daughter is abducted by human traffickers, he begins a dangerous search to bring her home, uncovering a wider network of corruption along the way.

movies.title: The Equalizer
movies.plot: A quiet hardware store worker with a mysterious past steps out of retirement after meeting a vulnerable young woman controlled by violent gangsters. Using carefully honed skills, he takes on increasingly dangerous enemies while trying to protect people who have nowhere else to turn.

movies.title: The Conjuring 2
movies.plot: A married pair of paranormal investigators travel to north London to help a single mother and her four children, who are facing disturbing supernatural activity in their home. As fear and doubt grow, the investigators must determine whether the family is experiencing a genuine haunting or something more complicated.

movies.title: Fifty Shades of Grey
movies.plot: A college senior interviews a wealthy, enigmatic businessman after filling in for her sick roommate. Their attraction grows into an intense affair, but his unconventional desires challenge her boundaries and force them to confront what each wants from the relationship.

movies.title: The Hangover
movies.plot: After a wild bachelor-party night in Las Vegas, three friends wake up with no memory of what happened, a baby and a tiger in their suite, and the groom missing. They race to retrace their steps, uncover clues, and reach the wedding on time.

movies.title: Ice Age: Continental Drift
movies.plot: When a continent breaks apart, a mammoth, sloth, and saber-toothed tiger are swept out to sea on an iceberg. As they search for a way home, they encounter unusual sea creatures, dangerous pirates, and a strange new world.

movies.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
movies.plot: A struggling salesman faces mounting financial pressure while caring for his young son. As they move through increasingly difficult circumstances, he pursues a demanding opportunity in the financial world, trying to build a more secure future through persistence, preparation, and hope.

movies.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides
movies.plot: A clever pirate is drawn into a dangerous quest for the fabled Fountain of Youth after crossing paths with a woman from his past. As rival forces pursue the same prize, shifting alliances, enchanted objects, and deadly mermaids complicate the search.

movies.title: 28 Days Later
movies.plot: Weeks after a deadly virus escapes from a research facility, a man awakens in an abandoned London and joins a small group of survivors. Together, they search for safety while avoiding infected people driven into violent, uncontrollable rage.

movies.title: Life Is Beautiful
movies.plot: An imaginative Italian bookseller falls in love, starts a family, and builds a joyful life. When war and persecution tear that life apart, he uses humor and an elaborate story to protect his young son from the frightening reality surrounding them.

movies.title: Heat
movies.plot: A highly disciplined thief leads a skilled crew through daring robberies across Los Angeles, while a relentless detective works to bring them down. As their cat-and-mouse pursuit intensifies, both men recognize a shared dedication to their chosen paths, even as personal pressures and dangerous consequences close in.

movies.title: Fuze
movies.plot: When an unexploded wartime bomb is found at a busy London construction site, police and military teams launch a mass evacuation. As specialists race to secure the device, a separate criminal operation nearby is thrown into confusion, creating a tense race against time.

movies.title: Aliens
movies.plot: After years adrift in hypersleep, a traumatized survivor returns to Earth and finds her warnings about a deadly extraterrestrial encounter dismissed. She agrees to join a heavily armed team investigating a remote colony that has suddenly gone silent, confronting a threat far larger than anyone expected.

movies.title: Total Recall
movies.plot: A construction worker obsessed with dreams of Mars visits a company that implants vacation memories. When the procedure goes wrong, he becomes caught in a dangerous pursuit and must question his identity, his past, and whether the events unfolding around him are real or manufactured.

movies.title: Primate
movies.plot: A college student returns to her family’s Hawaii home with friends, where they encounter a dangerous crisis involving the household’s pet chimpanzee. As the animal becomes increasingly violent, the group must find a way to survive while trapped in an isolated setting.

movies.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
movies.plot: After a global war, a seaside kingdom survives beside a poisonous jungle filled with powerful insects. A courageous young leader tries to protect her people while opposing forces clash, seeking a way to restore humanity’s fragile relationship with the damaged natural world.

movies.title: Dune
movies.plot: In a distant future, a powerful substance that extends life and enables space travel is found only on the desert planet Arrakis. When control of this resource is contested, a young heir becomes entangled with the planet’s people and their prophecy of a liberating messiah.

movies.title: The Family Plan 2
movies.plot: A former assassin hoping for a peaceful Christmas plans a family trip to London after discovering his daughter has other plans. Their holiday getaway quickly becomes dangerous when an unexpected enemy targets the family, forcing them to face trouble together.

movies.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants
movies.plot: A determined young sponge sets out to prove his bravery by joining a mysterious ghost pirate on a seafaring adventure. Their journey plunges into the deepest parts of the sea, where he faces strange creatures, dangerous challenges, and tests of loyalty and courage.

movies.title: The Wrong Girls
movies.plot: Two codependent best friends scraping by get caught in a case of mistaken identity, sending their already chaotic lives into even greater turmoil. As they try to handle the fallout, their loyalty and dependence are put under pressure.

movies.title: La familia Benetón +2
movies.plot: A devoted parent thinks life is under control in a lively, multicultural family, but the arrival of two new babies turns the household upside down. With twice the challenges come twice the adventures, as everyone adjusts to their rapidly changing family life.

movies.title: Onslaught
movies.plot: A highly trained Army sniper faces a dangerous squad of genetically engineered super soldiers after they break loose in the desert. As the threat closes in, she fights to protect her young daughter and survive a brutal confrontation.

movies.title: Voicemails for Isabelle
movies.plot: A young woman leaves hilariously confessional voicemails for her late sister, but the messages are unknowingly redirected to a stranger. As the stranger listens from afar, an unexpected connection begins to grow through her candid, intimate recordings.

movies.title: Bugonia
movies.plot: Two conspiracy-obsessed young men kidnap a powerful company CEO, convinced she is an alien planning to destroy Earth. As they hold her captive and demand answers, their strange mission becomes a tense, darkly comic clash of paranoia, power, and competing ideas about the truth.

movies.title: Poor Things
movies.plot: Brought back to life by an unorthodox scientist, a young woman leaves home with a lawyer for a whirlwind journey across continents. As she encounters new places, ideas, and relationships, she challenges the expectations placed on women and grows into an increasingly independent person.

movies.title: Mission: Impossible - Dead Reckoning Part One
movies.plot: A skilled field agent and an IMF team race around the globe to secure a dangerous new weapon before it reaches the wrong hands. Pursued by a powerful enemy connected to the agent’s past, they face shifting alliances, daring escapes, and impossible choices about loyalty and sacrifice.

movies.title: The Covenant
movies.plot: After an ambush in Afghanistan, a local interpreter risks everything to save a wounded American sergeant and return him to safety. When the interpreter and his family are left without the promised passage to America, the sergeant goes back into the war zone to repay his debt.

movies.title: The Running Man
movies.plot: A desperate working-class father enters a deadly televised competition to pay for his sick daughter’s medication. Hunted across the country by professional killers and ordinary citizens, he relies on instinct and determination while the show turns his struggle into mass entertainment.

movies.title: Evil Dead Rise
movies.plot: An estranged sister visits a single mother living with her children in a troubled apartment building. When a mysterious book unleashes flesh-possessing demons, the family becomes trapped in a brutal fight for survival, forced to confront a terrifying threat within their own home.

movies.title: The Suicide Squad
movies.plot: A group of imprisoned supervillains is forced into a secret government mission on a remote island controlled by hostile forces. Led by hardened specialists and joined by an unpredictable team of misfits, they must infiltrate a dangerous facility while facing overwhelming odds and their own volatile personalities.

movies.title: X-Men: Dark Phoenix
movies.plot: After a cosmic force transforms a powerful young mutant during a space rescue, she struggles to control her abilities and emotions. Her teammates must reach her before fear and outside forces turn her immense power into a threat to Earth and everyone around her.

movies.title: Normal
movies.plot: A quiet substitute sheriff arrives in a small town expecting routine work, but a bank robbery quickly pulls him into a dangerous situation involving powerful criminals, military-grade weapons, and buried secrets. As the night grows more chaotic, he must find help while confronting his own troubled past.

movies.title: Nobody 2
movies.plot: A former assassin takes his family on a nostalgic vacation to a small-town theme park, hoping to reconnect and relax. Their getaway quickly turns violent after a clash with criminals running the resort, forcing him to confront danger while trying to protect his loved ones.

movies.title: The Beekeeper
movies.plot: After a vulnerable woman is targeted by an online scam, a quiet beekeeper launches a relentless campaign against those responsible. His pursuit soon expands beyond personal revenge, drawing in law enforcement and exposing connections to powerful institutions.

movies.title: Ready Player One
movies.plot: After the creator of a hugely popular virtual world dies, users are challenged to find a hidden prize that grants control of the system. A young player joins forces with fellow competitors while facing corporate interests determined to seize the virtual world for themselves.

movies.title: Justice League
movies.plot: After Superman’s loss leaves Earth vulnerable, a determined hero and an Amazon warrior recruit a speedster, an underwater champion, a cybernetic survivor, and a returning powerhouse. Together, they face an ancient enemy and his monstrous forces, who seek powerful artifacts to launch an invasion and conquer the planet.

movies.title: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
movies.plot: In 1926, a British wizard arrives in New York with a magically expanded briefcase filled with unusual creatures and their habitats. When several escape, he joins forces with new acquaintances to find them while facing pressure from magical authorities and growing tensions between magical and non-magical communities.

movies.title: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
movies.plot: A hardened vigilante fears that a powerful alien hero could become an unchecked threat, while the alien struggles with humanity’s doubts about his role in the world. As their conflict intensifies, a dangerous new menace emerges, forcing them to confront a greater danger together.

movies.title: Mission: Impossible - Fallout
movies.plot: After an IMF mission goes wrong, a covert team must recover dangerous stolen materials and stop a plan that could cause global catastrophe. Hunted by assassins and questioned by the CIA, they race across the world while loyalties and motives come under pressure.

movies.title: The Croods
movies.plot: A prehistoric family survives by following strict rules and staying inside their cave, but a curious teenage daughter longs to explore. When a clever outsider warns that their world is changing, the family must leave home and face unfamiliar landscapes, dangerous creatures, and the challenge of adapting together.

movies.title: Catch Me If You Can
movies.plot: A teenage con artist runs away and survives by impersonating professionals, forging checks, and staying ahead of the law. An FBI agent relentlessly pursues him across the country, creating a playful cat-and-mouse story shaped by family troubles, risky schemes, and an unexpected sense of connection.

movies.title: Black Swan
movies.plot: A dedicated young dancer is pushed to her limits after earning the starring role in a demanding ballet production. As pressure from her work and personal life mounts, she struggles to protect her sense of reality while trying to embody contrasting sides of the performance.

movies.title: Twilight
movies.plot: A teenage girl moves to a rainy small town and falls for a mysterious classmate with a dangerous secret. As their intense romance develops, she becomes caught between ordinary school life and a supernatural threat that puts her safety at risk.

movies.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End
movies.plot: After a pirate captain is lost to a supernatural realm, a blacksmith, a determined young woman, and a returning pirate captain journey to the ends of the earth to rescue him. With a powerful company tightening its grip on the seas, pirates must unite for a final stand as loyalties and alliances are tested.

movies.title: Shrek the Third
movies.plot: After a kingdom’s ruler dies, an ogre and his wife face an unexpected claim to the throne. Hoping to return to a quiet life, the ogre travels with two friends to find another heir, while a rival makes plans to seize power.

movies.title: The Good Dinosaur
movies.plot: In a world where dinosaurs farm and humans live like wild animals, a timid young dinosaur is swept far from home. Along the way, he forms an unlikely friendship with a small human and faces dangerous wilderness challenges while learning to overcome fear.

movies.title: Over the Hedge
movies.plot: A raccoon persuades a group of forest animals to venture into a newly built suburb for food after their woodland home changes. Their risky raids bring them face to face with unfamiliar human habits and dangers, while the mismatched group begins to discover the value of trust and family.

movies.title: Snatch
movies.plot: A stolen diamond draws a chaotic mix of London criminals, boxing promoters, gangsters, amateur thieves, and an unpredictable bare-knuckle fighter into overlapping schemes. As rival groups chase the valuable prize, bungled robberies, dangerous deals, and a high-stakes boxing match send events spiraling into darkly comic mayhem.

movies.title: Memento
movies.plot: A man hunts for the person responsible for his wife's murder while coping with a rare condition that prevents him from forming new memories. He relies on tattoos, notes, and photographs to track clues, navigate uncertain alliances, and continue a dangerous investigation despite forgetting what happened moments earlier.

movies.title: Top Gun
movies.plot: A talented fighter pilot and his trusted co-pilot earn places at an elite training school, where intense competition and personal relationships test their ambitions. After a devastating event, the pilot must confront grief, self-doubt, and the pressure to prove himself among the best.

movies.title: Drawn Together
movies.plot: After a wealthy Spanish heiress is kidnapped, she falls into a dangerous attraction with the newly hired bodyguard assigned to protect her in a world full of deception.

movies.title: The Eagle
movies.plot: In 140 AD, twenty years after the unexplained disappearance of the entire Ninth Legion in the mountains of Scotland, young centurion Marcus Aquila arrives from Rome to solve the mystery and restore the reputation of his father, the commander of the Ninth. Accompanied only by his British slave Esca, Marcus sets out across Hadrian's Wall into the uncharted highlands of Caledonia - to confront its savage tribes, make peace with his father's memory, and retrieve the lost legion's golden emblem, the Eagle of the Ninth.

movies.title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
movies.plot: As Frank Castle searches for meaning beyond revenge, an unexpected force pulls him back into the fight.

movies.title: Grown Ups 2
movies.plot: Lenny has relocated his family back to the small town where he and his friends grew up. This time around, the grown ups are the ones learning lessons from their kids on a day notoriously full of surprises—the last day of school.

movies.title: Courage Under Fire
movies.plot: A US Army officer, who made a "friendly fire" mistake that was covered up, has been reassigned to a desk job. He is tasked to investigate a female chopper commander's worthiness to be awarded the Medal of Honor. At first all seems in order. But then he begins to notice inconsistencies between the testimonies of the witnesses...

movies.title: It Follows
movies.plot: A young woman is followed by an unknown supernatural force after a sexual encounter.

movies.title: Tell Me Softly
movies.plot: Kamila has everything under control: studies, social life, her image... Everything except the unexpected return of her neighbors, the Di Bianco brothers, after seven years of absence. Thiago stole her first kiss, and Taylor was her best friend, but now their return will turn Kami's world upside down. Can the three overcome the past that binds them? Or will everything explode into pieces once again?

movies.title: Ferrari
movies.plot: Set during the summer of 1957. Ex-racecar driver, Enzo Ferrari, is in crisis. Bankruptcy stalks the company he and his wife, Laura, built from nothing ten years earlier. Their tempestuous marriage struggles with the mourning for one son and the acknowledgement of another.

movies.title: Crawl
movies.plot: When a huge hurricane hits her hometown in Florida, Haley ignores evacuation orders to look for her father. After finding him badly wounded, both are trapped by the flood. With virtually no time to escape the storm, they discover that rising water levels are the least of their problems.

movies.title: Dark Angel
movies.plot: Jack Caine is a Houston vice cop who's forgotten the rule book. His self-appointed mission is to stop the drugs trade and the number one supplier Victor Manning. While involved in an undercover operation to entrap Victor Manning, his partner is killed, and a sinister newcomer enters the scene...

movies.title: Alone
movies.plot: A recently widowed traveler is kidnapped by a cold blooded killer, only to escape into the wilderness where she is forced to battle against the elements as her pursuer closes in on her.

movies.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
movies.plot: Humanity finds a mysterious object buried beneath the lunar surface and sets off to find its origins with the help of HAL 9000, the world's most advanced super computer.

movies.title: Hair
movies.plot: Upon receiving his draft notice and leaving his family ranch in Oklahoma, Claude heads to New York and befriends a tribe of long-haired hippies on his way to boot camp.

movies.title: L'été en pente douce
movies.plot: When he inherits the family house and property after his mother's death, aspiring novelist Fane returns home with his bimbo girlfriend Lilas. He must care for his idiot brother Mo and contend with a greedy garage owner who covets Fane's property to expand his business. When efforts to buy the property are fruitless, the mechanic incites the townsfolk against the strange trio.

movies.title: Wicked: For Good
movies.plot: As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, Glinda and Elphaba must unite one last time with honesty and empathy to fulfill their shared destiny and change the fate of Oz forever.

movies.title: Pressure
movies.plot: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

movies.title: Seven Snipers
movies.plot: When a former elite sniper is hunted down by the ruthless warlord who once held her captive, she must fight to the death to protect the daughter she has raised in hiding, on a remote Australian farm.

movies.title: Passenger
movies.plot: After a young couple witnesses a gruesome highway accident, they soon realize they did not leave the crash scene alone, as a demonic presence called the Passenger that won't stop until it claims them both turns their van life adventure into a nightmare.

movies.title: Kissing Is the Easy Part
movies.plot: Sean's gunning for MIT. Flora's ditching the SAT. A secret deal with her tenured parents sparks a romance that challenges everything they believe in.

movies.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay - Part 1
movies.plot: After surviving the Quarter Quell, Katniss finds herself in the hidden stronghold of District 13, where the rebellion against the Capitol is gaining momentum. Struggling with the weight of becoming the symbol of resistance, she must navigate fragile alliances while trying to protect those she loves. As propaganda battles rage and Panem moves closer to full-scale war, Katniss is forced to confront the true cost of revolution.

movies.title: Exploits of a Young Don Juan
movies.plot: In 1914, sixteen year old Roger returned home from boarding school during vacation to find his puberty hit hard in a house filled with beautiful women. These women have previous engagements with other men who are away, and during this time, Roger impregnates them all, including his aunt and sister, then devises plans to cuckold the men.

movies.title: The Cat in the Hat
movies.plot: During a rainy day, and while their mother is out, Conrad and Sally, and their pet fish, are visited by the mischievous Cat in the Hat. Fun soon turns to mayhem, and the siblings must figure out how to rid themselves of the maniacal Cat.

movies.title: Farewell My Concubine
movies.plot: In an epic tale of theater, gender, love and class, two Beijing opera actors navigate political turmoil as their friendship evolves over decades.

movies.title: The Proposal
movies.plot: When she learns she's in danger of losing her visa status and being deported, overbearing book editor Margaret Tate forces her put-upon assistant, Andrew Paxton, to marry her.

movies.title: Descendants: Wicked Wonderland
movies.plot: Now that the Queen of Hearts is nice and Cinderella is safe, things seem perfect for Red and Chloe… But little do they know that changing the past created a new villain — Maddox Hatter. When Maddox captures the Queen of Hearts, Red and Chloe must work alongside Red’s new sister Pink, Luisa Madrigal’s son Luis, and Maddox’s son Max to save her and Wonderland.

movies.title: Kingdom of Heaven
movies.plot: After his wife dies, a blacksmith named Balian is thrust into royalty, political intrigue and bloody holy wars during the Crusades.

movies.title: Bazaar (Murder in the Building)
movies.plot: Misanthropic novelist François writes gripping crime stories – “Agatha Christie meets The Scarlet Pimpernel” – but outside of the swashbuckling imaginary world of his Marquis la Rose-novels, life is far from thrilling. His partner Colette, a professor at the Sorbonne and world-renowned expert on Alfred Hitchcock, is tired of watching François sit around their apartment in his pyjamas and yearns for the excitement of the classic films she watches with her students. When Colette begins to suspect their flamboyant actor neighbour of murdering his wife, the couple’s mundane lives are turned upside down – and their stale relationship is jolted back to life.

movies.title: The Sixth Sense
movies.plot: Following an unexpected tragedy, child psychologist Malcolm Crowe meets a nine year old boy named Cole Sear, who is hiding a dark secret.

movies.title: Queen of Spades: The Dark Rite
movies.plot: There is an ancient ritual known to humankind for more than a hundred years...According to the legend, an ominous entity known as The Queen of Spades can be summoned by drawing a door and staircase on a mirror in the darkness, and by saying her name three times. The Queen of Spades gets her energy from reflective objects; she cuts locks of hair from those asleep, and those that see her go mad or die. Four teenagers decide to call The Queen of Spades as a joke. But when one of them dies of a sudden heart attack, the group realizes they are up against something inexplicable and deadly dangerous.

movies.title: The Notebook
movies.plot: An epic love story centered around an older man who reads aloud to a woman with Alzheimer's. From a faded notebook, the old man's words bring to life the story about a couple who is separated by World War II, and is then passionately reunited, seven years later, after they have taken different paths.

movies.title: The Handmaiden
movies.plot: 1930s Korea, in the period of Japanese occupation, a new girl, Sook-hee, is hired as a handmaiden to a Japanese heiress, Hideko, who lives a secluded life on a large countryside estate with her domineering Uncle Kouzuki. But the maid has a secret. She is a pickpocket recruited by a swindler posing as a Japanese Count to help him seduce the Lady to steal her fortune.

movies.title: All the Invisible Children
movies.plot: Seven short films - each one focused on the plight of a different child protagonist.

movies.title: A Serbian Film
